lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: Before the roads filled with ash, Veyrhold measured its days in bells. A sound from the tower meant another hour had passed.
lines.ja: 道という道が灰に埋もれる前、ヴェアホルドの人々は鐘の音で日々を測っていた。塔から響くひと打ちは、またひとつの刻が過ぎたことを告げていた。
lines.tts_text: 道という道が灰に埋もれる前、<short pause> ヴェアホルドの人々は鐘の音で日々を測っていた。<long pause> 塔から響くひと打ちは、<short pause> またひとつの刻が過ぎたことを告げていた。

Maintain a single, unwavering, deeply calm, ethereal, and reverent tone from beginning to end—like an ancient spirit speaking quietly from beyond time, with steady, unhurried pacing and completely uniform pitch, warmth, and timbre across every paragraph.
lines.context: Opening prologue over painted plates, scene 'Before the Road'.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: People carved their names on doors and trees, and wrote them in roadside registers. Not for fame. So someone would remember that they had been here.
lines.ja: 人々は扉や樹々に自らの名を刻み、道端の台帳にその名を書き残した。名声のためではない。確かにここに生きていたと、誰かが覚えていてくれるように。
lines.tts_text: 人々は扉や樹々に自らの名を刻み、<short pause> 道端の台帳にその名を書き残した。<long pause> 名声のためではない。<short pause> 確かにここに生きていたと、<short pause> 誰かが覚えていてくれるように。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: There were markets, journeys, and doors that opened to strangers. Small things, easily forgotten. Until the day people began to lose them.
lines.ja: 市が立ち、旅人が行き交い、見知らぬ者にも扉は開かれていた。すぐに忘れ去られるような、ささやかな日常。それを失い始める日が来るまでは。
lines.tts_text: 市が立ち、旅人が行き交い、<short pause> 見知らぬ者にも扉は開かれていた。<short pause> すぐに忘れ去られるような、ささやかな日常。<long pause>  それを失い始める日が来るまでは。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: The great houses fought over a throne. Fields emptied. Families took to the roads, carrying what they could. The war drew closer to the capital.
lines.ja: 諸侯はひとつの玉座を巡って争った。畑からは人が消え、家族は持てるものだけを抱えて街道へと出た。戦火は、やがて王都へと迫っていった。
lines.tts_text: 諸侯はひとつの玉座を巡って争った。<short pause> 畑からは人が消え、<short pause> 家族は持てるものだけを抱えて街道へと出た。<long pause> 戦火は、<short pause> やがて王都へと迫っていった。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: Then came Crownfall. The capital fell. The king died. By dawn, survivors were leaving behind streets they had once known by heart.
lines.ja: そして、『王冠落ち』の日が訪れた。王都は陥ち、王は斃れた。夜が明ける頃、生き残った者たちは、かつて知り尽くしていたはずの街路を後にした。
lines.tts_text: そして、<short pause> 『王冠落ち』の日が訪れた。<long pause> 王都は陥ち、<short pause> 王は斃れた。<long pause> 夜が明ける頃、<short pause> 生き残った者たちは、かつて知り尽くしていたはずの街路を後にした。

lines.context: Opening prologue over painted plates, scene 'Six Years Ago'.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: They carried blankets, tools, and the names of those who had not come with them. Beyond the walls, the roads were still there. Home was not.
lines.ja: 彼らが背負ったのは、毛布と道具、そして共に来られなかった者たちの名だった。城壁の向こうに道はまだ続いていた。だが、帰るべき家はもうなかった。
lines.tts_text: 彼らが背負ったのは、<short pause> 毛布と道具、<short pause> そして共に来られなかった者たちの名だった。<long pause> 城壁の向こうに道はまだ続いていた。<long pause>  だが、<short pause> 帰るべき家はもうなかった。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: Among the travelers was a knight who searched the village registers for one name. Village after village, winter after winter, he kept looking.
lines.ja: 旅人たちのなかに、ただひとつの名を求めて村々の台帳を辿る騎士がいた。村から村へ、冬から冬へと、彼は探し続けた。
lines.tts_text: 旅人たちのなかに、<short pause> ただひとつの名を求めて村々の台帳を辿る騎士がいた。<long pause> 村から村へ、<short pause> 冬から冬へと、<short pause> 彼は探し続けた。
lines.direction: Speak in a serene, spiritual, otherworldly, and timeless mystical narrator voice. Maintain a single, unwavering, deeply calm, ethereal, and reverent tone from beginning to end—like an ancient spirit speaking quietly from beyond time, with steady, unhurried pacing and completely uniform pitch, warmth, and timbre across every paragraph.
lines.context: Opening prologue over painted plates, scene 'A Name on the Road'.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: In a hill village, he found her. She asked him to stay. He did. The road ahead would no longer be hers alone.
lines.ja: ある丘の村で、彼はついに彼女を見つけた。傍にいてほしいと彼女は願い、彼は頷いた。その先の道は、もはや彼女ひとりのものではなくなった。
lines.tts_text: ある丘の村で、<short pause> 彼はついに彼女を見つけた。<long pause> 傍にいてほしいと彼女は願い、<short pause> 彼は頷いた。<long pause> その先の道は、<short pause> もはや彼女ひとりのものではなくなった。

lines.context: Opening prologue over painted plates, scene 'Found Again'.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: Now Fadyme and Mahmut walk together. The bells still ring. Neither has told the other everything. This is where their story begins.
lines.ja: いま、ファディメとマフムトは共に歩いている。鐘はいまも鳴り響き、ふたりはまだ互いのすべてを語ってはいない。ここから、ふたりの物語が始まる。
lines.tts_text: いま、<short pause> ファディメとマフムトは共に歩いている。<short pause> 鐘はいまも鳴り響き、<short pause> ふたりはまだ互いのすべてを語ってはいない。<long pause>  ここから、<short pause> ふたりの物語が始まる。
lines.direction: Speak in a serene, spiritual, otherworldly, and timeless mystical narrator voice. Maintain a single, unwavering, deeply calm, ethereal, and reverent tone from beginning to end—like an ancient spirit speaking quietly from beyond time, with steady, unhurried pacing and completely uniform pitch, warmth, and timbre across every paragraph.
lines.context: Opening prologue over painted plates, scene 'The Journey Begins'.

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Are you hurt?
lines.ja: 怪我はないか？
lines.tts_text: <breath> 怪我はないか？
lines.direction: Immediate, quiet concern; low baritone asking simply and directly.
lines.context: Scene 'The First Step'. First line of the scene.

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Only my opinion of this road.
lines.ja: この道への評価だけ、傷ついたわ。
lines.tts_text: この道への評価だけ、<short pause> 傷ついたわ。
lines.direction: Light, dryly amused alto; reassuring him with effortless wit.
lines.context: Scene 'The First Step'. Answering Mahmut: "Are you hurt?"

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Your sleeve.
lines.ja: 袖が。
lines.tts_text: <short pause> 袖が。
lines.direction: Observant, low baritone; brief and attentive as he notices a tear or leaf on her sleeve.
lines.context: Scene 'The First Step'. Answering Fadyme: "Only my opinion of this road."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: A branch. It has dreadful manners.
lines.ja: 枝よ。ひどく行儀の悪い枝だったわ。
lines.tts_text: 枝よ。<short pause> ひどく行儀の悪い枝だったわ。
lines.direction: Poised, dryly humorous alto; speaking of a forest branch as if it were an impolite guest.
lines.context: Scene 'The First Step'. Answering Mahmut: "Your sleeve."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: We can rest here.
lines.ja: ここで休んでいってもいい。
lines.tts_text: ここで休んでいってもいい。
lines.direction: Quiet, considerate low baritone; offering rest without pressing.
lines.context: Scene 'The First Step'. Answering Fadyme: "A branch. It has dreadful manners."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: In the mud? I was hoping your invitation would improve.
lines.ja: 泥の中で？ もう少し素敵なお誘いを期待していたのに。
lines.tts_text: 泥の中で？ <short pause> <chuckle> もう少し素敵なお誘いを期待していたのに。
lines.direction: Playful, teasing alto; gentle lift on 'In the mud?', followed by warm dry wit.
lines.context: Scene 'The First Step'. Answering Mahmut: "We can rest here."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: A dry stone, then.
lines.ja: なら、乾いた石の上だ。
lines.tts_text: なら、<short pause> 乾いた石の上だ。
lines.direction: Dry, warm baritone comeback; brief and fond.
lines.context: Scene 'The First Step'. Answering Fadyme: "In the mud? I was hoping your invitation would improve."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Tempting. A roof would make it irresistible.
lines.ja: 魅力的ね。屋根まであれば、断れなくなりそう。
lines.tts_text: 魅力的ね。<short pause> 屋根まであれば、<short pause> 断れなくなりそう。
lines.direction: Warm, charming alto with a soft smile; light and unhurried.
lines.context: Scene 'The First Step'. Answering Mahmut: "A dry stone, then."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: There should be shelter farther along. We stop if you need to.
lines.ja: もう少し進めば、雨風を凌げる場所があるはずだ。だが、お前が休みたいならいつでも止まる。
lines.tts_text: もう少し進めば、雨風を凌げる場所があるはずだ。<long pause> だが、<short pause> お前が休みたいならいつでも止まる。
lines.direction: Steady, protective baritone; practical planning softened by attentive care for her stamina.
lines.context: Scene 'The First Step'. Answering Fadyme: "Tempting. A roof would make it irresistible."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: If either of us needs to. That is the arrangement.
lines.ja: どちらかが必要としたら、よ。そういう約束でしょう。
lines.tts_text: どちらかが必要としたら、よ。<short pause> そういう約束でしょう。
lines.direction: Poised, earnest alto; gentle firmness reminding him that they look after each other equally.
lines.context: Scene 'The First Step'. Answering Mahmut: "There should be shelter farther along. We stop if you need to."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Agreed.
lines.ja: ああ、そうだな。
lines.tts_text: <short pause> ああ、そうだな。
lines.direction: Soft, grounded baritone; quiet acceptance.
lines.context: Scene 'The First Step'. Answering Fadyme: "If either of us needs to. That is the arrangement."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Keep to the stones. The mud gets deeper ahead.
lines.ja: 敷石の上を歩け。この先は泥が深くなる。
lines.tts_text: 敷石の上を歩け。<short pause> この先は泥が深くなる。
lines.direction: Low, watchful baritone; grounded, practical guidance spoken quietly while scanning the road ahead.
lines.context: Scene 'The First Step'. First line of the scene.

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: The stones have already claimed one boot.
lines.ja: その石にも、もう靴を片方取られたわ。
lines.tts_text: <chuckle> その石にも、<short pause> もう靴を片方取られたわ。
lines.direction: Light, poised alto with dry, aristocratic amusement; gently teasing her companion without complaining.
lines.context: Scene 'The First Step'. Answering Mahmut: "Keep to the stones. The mud gets deeper ahead."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Both boots are still with us.
lines.ja: まだ両方とも、ちゃんと履いているだろう。
lines.tts_text: <exhales> まだ両方とも、<short pause> ちゃんと履いているだろう。
lines.direction: Deadpan, fond dry humor in a low baritone; a faint wry smile in the voice.
lines.context: Scene 'The First Step'. Answering Fadyme: "The stones have already claimed one boot."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: You have a comforting way of counting disasters.
lines.ja: 災難を数えるのが、お上手ね。安心できる数え方だわ。
lines.tts_text: 災難を数えるのが、お上手ね。<short pause> 安心できる数え方だわ。
lines.direction: Warm, wryly affectionate alto; unhurried pause between sentences with a soft smile.
lines.context: Scene 'The First Step'. Answering Mahmut: "Both boots are still with us."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: That one is loose. Give me your hand.
lines.ja: その石は緩んでいる。手を貸せ。
lines.tts_text: その石は緩んでいる。<short pause> 手を貸せ。
lines.direction: Quiet, steady, protective baritone; simple and direct as he reaches out his hand.
lines.context: Scene 'The First Step'. Answering Fadyme: "You have a comforting way of counting disasters."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: For the stone, or for the whole road?
lines.ja: その石を渡る間だけ？ それとも、この道の終わりまで？
lines.tts_text: その石を渡る間だけ？ <short pause> それとも、<short pause> この道の終わりまで？
lines.direction: Playful, teasing alto with quiet intimacy; pausing between the two questions.
lines.context: Scene 'The First Step'. Answering Mahmut: "That one is loose. Give me your hand."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: The stone first.
lines.ja: まずは、その石からだ。
lines.tts_text: まずは、<short pause> その石からだ。
lines.direction: Low, warm baritone with understated dry humor; unhurried and quietly fond.
lines.context: Scene 'The First Step'. Answering Fadyme: "For the stone, or for the whole road?"

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: There. An excellent rescue. Very little applause, unfortunately.
lines.ja: ほら、見事な救出だったわ。残念ながら、拍手はほとんどないけれど。
lines.tts_text: ほら、見事な救出だったわ。<short pause> 残念ながら、<short pause> 拍手はほとんどないけれど。
lines.direction: Light, witty alto; covering a tender moment with charming dry humor.
lines.context: Scene 'The First Step'. Answering Mahmut: "The stone first."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: We can live with that.
lines.ja: それくらいは、我慢できるさ。
lines.tts_text: それくらいは、<short pause> 我慢できるさ。
lines.direction: Relaxed, warm low baritone; dryly content.
lines.context: Scene 'The First Step'. Answering Fadyme: "There. An excellent rescue. Very little applause, unfortunately."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Two of them. Stay beside the wall.
lines.ja: 二体いる。壁のそばを離れるな。
lines.tts_text: 二体いる。<short pause> 壁のそばを離れるな。
lines.direction: Firm, protective combat baritone; low, urgent, and commanding without shouting.
lines.context: Scene 'The First Step'. Answering Mahmut: "We can live with that."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Beside it. Not behind you. I know the difference.
lines.ja: 壁の横ね。あなたの後ろじゃなくて。その違いは分かっているわ。
lines.tts_text: 壁の横ね。<short pause> あなたの後ろじゃなくて。<short pause> その違いは分かっているわ。
lines.direction: Clear, resolute alto with poised pride; crisp pauses between short sentences as she steps into battle beside him.
lines.context: Scene 'The First Step'. Answering Mahmut: "Two of them. Stay beside the wall."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Sit. The trees have survived your inspection.
lines.ja: 座って。木々も、あなたの見回りを無事に切り抜けたことだし。
lines.tts_text: <chuckle> 座って。<short pause> 木々も、あなたの見回りを無事に切り抜けたことだし。
lines.direction: Warm, dryly amused alto; gently teasing his relentless vigilance.
lines.context: Scene 'A Road Forgotten'. First line of the scene.

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: This strap needs tightening.
lines.ja: この革帯を締め直さないとな。
lines.tts_text: この革帯を締め直さないとな。
lines.direction: Matter-of-fact low baritone; practical soldier checking his gear.
lines.context: Scene 'A Road Forgotten'. Answering Fadyme: "Sit. The trees have survived your inspection."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Then hold still. Even your armour is asking for a rest.
lines.ja: それなら、じっとしていて。鎧まで休みたがっているわ。
lines.tts_text: それなら、じっとしていて。<short pause> 鎧まで休みたがっているわ。
lines.direction: Affectionate, lightly scolding alto; gentle warmth beneath dry wit.
lines.context: Scene 'A Road Forgotten'. Answering Mahmut: "This strap needs tightening."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: I can do that.
lines.ja: 自分でできる。
lines.tts_text: 自分でできる。
lines.direction: Soft, slightly sheepish low baritone; quiet protest without pulling his arm away.
lines.context: Scene 'A Road Forgotten'. Answering Fadyme: "Then hold still. Even your armour is asking for a rest."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: I know. You can also let me.
lines.ja: 知っているわ。私に任せることだって、できるでしょう。
lines.tts_text: 知っているわ。<short pause> 私に任せることだって、<short pause> できるでしょう。
lines.direction: Calm, tender alto; quiet intimacy that disarms his stoic habit.
lines.context: Scene 'A Road Forgotten'. Answering Mahmut: "I can do that."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Too tight?
lines.ja: きつすぎないか？
lines.tts_text: きつすぎないか？
lines.direction: Hushed, slightly distracted low baritone spoken at close distance.
lines.context: Scene 'A Road Forgotten'. Answering Fadyme: "I know. You can also let me."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: You are supposed to answer that.
lines.ja: それは、あなたが答えるところでしょう。
lines.tts_text: <chuckle> それは、<short pause> あなたが答えるところでしょう。
lines.direction: Soft, wryly amused alto; gentle teasing.
lines.context: Scene 'A Road Forgotten'. Answering Mahmut: "Too tight?"

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: No.
lines.ja: いや。
lines.tts_text: <short pause> いや。
lines.direction: Deadpan, warm single-word reply in a low baritone.
lines.context: Scene 'A Road Forgotten'. Answering Fadyme: "You are supposed to answer that."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: A wonderfully detailed report.
lines.ja: なんて詳しい報告かしら。
lines.tts_text: なんて詳しい報告かしら。
lines.direction: Affectionate, lightly ironic alto with a soft smile.
lines.context: Scene 'A Road Forgotten'. Answering Mahmut: "No."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: The buckle is sound. The work is good.
lines.ja: 留め金はしっかりしている。手際もいい。
lines.tts_text: 留め金はしっかりしている。<short pause> 手際もいい。
lines.direction: Earnest yet dryly humorous low baritone; offering a genuine compliment in soldierly terms.
lines.context: Scene 'A Road Forgotten'. Answering Fadyme: "A wonderfully detailed report."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Careful. Another sentence and I might mistake that for a compliment.
lines.ja: 気をつけて。もう一言続けたら、褒め言葉だと勘違いしてしまいそう。
lines.tts_text: 気をつけて。<short pause> もう一言続けたら、<short pause> 褒め言葉だと勘違いしてしまいそう。
lines.direction: Playful, witty alto; unhurried and charming.
lines.context: Scene 'A Road Forgotten'. Answering Mahmut: "The buckle is sound. The work is good."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: It was one.
lines.ja: 褒め言葉だ。
lines.tts_text: 褒め言葉だ。
lines.direction: Simple, disarming sincerity in a warm low baritone.
lines.context: Scene 'A Road Forgotten'. Answering Fadyme: "Careful. Another sentence and I might mistake that for a compliment."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: There. Your turn to be looked after.
lines.ja: ほら。今度は、あなたが気遣ってもらう番よ。
lines.tts_text: <breath> ほら。<short pause> 今度は、あなたが気遣ってもらう番よ。
lines.direction: Gentle, heartfelt alto; warm and satisfied.
lines.context: Scene 'A Road Forgotten'. Answering Mahmut: "It was one."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: We should do that more evenly.
lines.ja: お互い、もう少し対等にやるべきだな。
lines.tts_text: お互い、<short pause> もう少し対等にやるべきだな。
lines.direction: Warm, grounded low baritone; closing the scene on quiet mutual care.
lines.context: Scene 'A Road Forgotten'. Answering Fadyme: "There. Your turn to be looked after."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: It has crossed this patch three times.
lines.ja: 同じ場所を、もう三度も横切っている。
lines.tts_text: 同じ場所を、<short pause> もう三度も横切っている。
lines.direction: Low, observant baritone; quiet, analytical soldier's tone.
lines.context: Scene 'A Road Forgotten'. First line of the scene.

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Perhaps the road used to end here.
lines.ja: 昔は、ここが道の終わりだったのかもしれないわ。
lines.tts_text: 昔は、<short pause> ここが道の終わりだったのかもしれないわ。
lines.direction: Soft, contemplative alto; wistful and gently empathetic.
lines.context: Scene 'A Road Forgotten'. Answering Mahmut: "It has crossed this patch three times."

lines.speaker: mahmut

lines.en: I would rather we reached somewhere ordinary. With an especially ordinary supper.

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: That can be arranged.
lines.ja: それなら、手配できるさ。
lines.tts_text: それなら、<short pause> 手配できるさ。

lines.en: It has seen us. Keep room to move.

lines.en: Dry enough here. The far corner is better.

lines.context: Scene 'A Roof Before Dawn'. Answering Mahmut: "Dry enough here. The far corner is better."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: It is not a large house.
lines.ja: それほど大きな家じゃないからな。
lines.tts_text: それほど大きな家じゃないからな。
lines.direction: Deadpan, warm low baritone.
lines.context: Scene 'A Roof Before Dawn'. Answering Fadyme: "You have inspected the entire house in one breath."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: This seat appears to be available.
lines.ja: こちらの席は、空いているようだけれど。

lines.context: Scene 'A Roof Before Dawn'. Answering Mahmut: "It is not a large house."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: I will check the doorway.

lines.tts_text: 戸口を確かめてくる。
lines.direction: Dutiful, slightly hesitant low baritone.

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: You checked it on the way in.
lines.ja: 入るときに、もう調べたでしょう。
lines.tts_text: 入るときに、<short pause> もう調べたでしょう。

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: From the other side.
lines.ja: あれは外側からだ。
lines.tts_text: あれは外側からだ。

lines.context: Scene 'A Roof Before Dawn'. Answering Fadyme: "You checked it on the way in."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: An important distinction. Sit before you discover a third side.

lines.context: Scene 'A Roof Before Dawn'. Answering Mahmut: "From the other side."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: We have enough bread for tonight.
lines.ja: 今夜の分のパンは足りる。
lines.tts_text: 今夜の分のパンは足りる。
lines.direction: Calm, grounded low baritone; quiet domestic comfort.
lines.context: Scene 'A Roof Before Dawn'. Answering Fadyme: "An important distinction. Sit before you discover a third side."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Actual bread, or another of your possibilities?
lines.ja: ちゃんとしたパン？ それとも、また「あるかもしれない」という話？
lines.tts_text: ちゃんとしたパン？ <short pause> それとも、<short pause> また「あるかもしれない」という話？

lines.context: Scene 'A Roof Before Dawn'. Answering Mahmut: "We have enough bread for tonight."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Actual bread.
lines.ja: ちゃんとしたパンだ。
lines.tts_text: ちゃんとしたパンだ。
lines.direction: Warm, deadpan low baritone with a quiet smile.
lines.context: Scene 'A Roof Before Dawn'. Answering Fadyme: "Actual bread, or another of your possibilities?"

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: A roof and a supper. You should announce your successes more often.
lines.ja: 屋根と夕食。もっと頻繁に、成果を発表するべきだわ。
lines.tts_text: 屋根と夕食。<short pause> もっと頻繁に、<short pause> 成果を発表するべきだわ。
lines.direction: Warm, genuinely delighted alto; soft gratitude wrapped in gentle wit.
lines.context: Scene 'A Roof Before Dawn'. Answering Mahmut: "Actual bread."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: You gave me more.
lines.ja: 俺の方が大きいぞ。
lines.tts_text: 俺の方が大きいぞ。
lines.direction: Gentle, observant low baritone; mild protest.
lines.context: Scene 'A Roof Before Dawn'. Answering Fadyme: "A roof and a supper. You should announce your successes more often."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: A flaw in the architecture of the loaf. Quite beyond my control.
lines.ja: パンの構造上の欠陥ね。私の手には負えなかったわ。
lines.tts_text: <chuckle> パンの構造上の欠陥ね。<short pause> 私の手には負えなかったわ。
lines.direction: Charming, deadpan aristocratic wit in a warm alto; pretending innocence.
lines.context: Scene 'A Roof Before Dawn'. Answering Mahmut: "You gave me more."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Tomorrow we find a better one.
lines.ja: 明日は、もう少し出来のいいパンを見つけよう。
lines.tts_text: 明日は、<short pause> もう少し出来のいいパンを見つけよう。
lines.direction: Warm, quiet low baritone; accepting her kindness.
lines.context: Scene 'A Roof Before Dawn'. Answering Fadyme: "A flaw in the architecture of the loaf. Quite beyond my control."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Tomorrow. Yes.
lines.ja: 明日。ええ。
lines.tts_text: 明日。<long pause> <breath> ええ。
lines.direction: Hushed, wistful alto; a quiet pause between 'Tomorrow' and 'Yes'.
lines.context: Scene 'A Roof Before Dawn'. Answering Mahmut: "Tomorrow we find a better one."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: What is it?
lines.ja: どうした？
lines.tts_text: どうした？
lines.direction: Gentle, attentive low baritone; quiet concern.
lines.context: Scene 'A Roof Before Dawn'. Answering Fadyme: "Tomorrow. Yes."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Nothing that needs solving tonight.
lines.ja: 今夜、解決しなくてもいいことよ。
lines.tts_text: 今夜、<short pause> 解決しなくてもいいことよ。
lines.direction: Guarded, gentle alto; trying to set her burden aside for the night.
lines.context: Scene 'A Roof Before Dawn'. Answering Mahmut: "What is it?"

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: It does not have to need solving.
lines.ja: 解決しなければならないことじゃなくてもいい。
lines.tts_text: 解決しなければならないことじゃなくてもいい。
lines.direction: Deeply patient, unhurried low baritone; offering unconditional presence without demanding answers.
lines.context: Scene 'A Roof Before Dawn'. Answering Fadyme: "Nothing that needs solving tonight."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Stay a little while. Before you stand watch.
lines.ja: 少しだけ、ここにいて。見張りに立つ前に。
lines.tts_text: <breath> 少しだけ、ここにいて。<long pause> 見張りに立つ前に。
lines.direction: Soft, unguarded, vulnerable alto; a quiet, earnest request.
lines.context: Scene 'A Roof Before Dawn'. Answering Mahmut: "It does not have to need solving."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: I am here.
lines.ja: ここにいるさ。
lines.tts_text: ここにいるさ。
lines.direction: Warm, steady low baritone; quiet anchor.
lines.context: Scene 'A Roof Before Dawn'. Answering Fadyme: "Stay a little while. Before you stand watch."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: I know. That was why I asked.
lines.ja: 知っているわ。だから、お願いしたの。
lines.tts_text: 知っているわ。<short pause> だから、<short pause> お願いしたの。
lines.direction: Tender, heartfelt alto; soft warmth and quiet trust.
lines.context: Scene 'A Roof Before Dawn'. Answering Mahmut: "I am here."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: We leave when there is light. No hurry.
lines.ja: 明るくなってから発とう。急ぐ旅じゃない。
lines.tts_text: 明るくなってから発とう。<short pause> 急ぐ旅じゃない。
lines.direction: Gentle, unhurried low baritone; reassuring and calm.
lines.context: Scene 'A Roof Before Dawn'. Answering Fadyme: "I know. That was why I asked."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: And no walking two steps ahead.
lines.ja: 二歩先を歩くのも、なしね。
lines.tts_text: 二歩先を歩くのも、<short pause> なしね。
lines.direction: Affectionate, softly smiling alto; gentle reminder to walk side by side.
lines.context: Scene 'A Roof Before Dawn'. Answering Mahmut: "We leave when there is light. No hurry."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Beside you, then.
lines.ja: なら、お前の隣だ。
lines.tts_text: なら、<short pause> お前の隣だ。
lines.direction: Warm, devoted low baritone; quiet promise.
lines.context: Scene 'A Roof Before Dawn'. Answering Fadyme: "And no walking two steps ahead."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Then.
lines.ja: ええ、そうして。
lines.tts_text: <breath> ええ、<short pause> そうして。
lines.direction: Soft, lingering alto whisper filled with quiet peace and acceptance.
lines.context: Scene 'A Roof Before Dawn'. Answering Mahmut: "Beside you, then."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: A roof. We stop there.
lines.ja: 屋根があるな。あそこで足を止めよう。
lines.tts_text: 屋根があるな。<short pause> あそこで足を止めよう。
lines.direction: Steady, quietly pleased low baritone.
lines.context: Scene 'A Roof Before Dawn'. First line of the scene.

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: You make it sound as though you ordered it specially.
lines.ja: わざわざ注文しておいたみたいな言い方ね。
lines.tts_text: <chuckle> わざわざ注文しておいたみたいな言い方ね。
lines.direction: Light, teasing alto with dry aristocratic wit.
lines.context: Scene 'A Roof Before Dawn'. Answering Mahmut: "A roof. We stop there."

lines.en: I would have asked for fewer holes.
lines.ja: 俺が注文したなら、もう少し穴を減らしてもらうさ。
lines.tts_text: 俺が注文したなら、<short pause> もう少し穴を減らしてもらうさ。
lines.direction: Dry, deadpan knightly humor in a warm low baritone.
lines.context: Scene 'A Roof Before Dawn'. Answering Fadyme: "You make it sound as though you ordered it specially."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: No view of the stars? A severe oversight.
lines.ja: 星の見えない屋根を？ それは重大な見落としね。
lines.tts_text: 星の見えない屋根を？ <short pause> それは重大な見落としね。
lines.direction: Playful, warm alto with a soft smile; gentle pause between clauses.
lines.context: Scene 'A Roof Before Dawn'. Answering Mahmut: "I would have asked for fewer holes."

lines.en: I can see the stars outside. I would rather keep the rain there too.
lines.ja: 星なら外で見られる。雨も一緒に外に置いておきたいからな。
lines.tts_text: 星なら外で見られる。<short pause> 雨も一緒に外に置いておきたいからな。
lines.direction: Warm, practical dry humor in a low baritone.
lines.context: Scene 'A Roof Before Dawn'. Answering Fadyme: "No view of the stars? A severe oversight."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: The doorway. Two more by the steps.
lines.ja: 戸口だ。階段の脇にもあと二体いる。
lines.tts_text: 戸口だ。<short pause> 階段の脇にもあと二体いる。
lines.direction: Taut, low combat callout; immediate shift from banter to soldierly focus.
lines.context: Scene 'A Roof Before Dawn'. Answering Mahmut: "I can see the stars outside. I would rather keep the rain there too."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: The previous tenants seem reluctant to leave.
lines.ja: 前の住人たちは、出ていく気がないようね。
lines.tts_text: 前の住人たちは、<short pause> 出ていく気がないようね。
lines.direction: Cool, poised alto with dry composure in the face of danger.
lines.context: Scene 'A Roof Before Dawn'. Answering Mahmut: "The doorway. Two more by the steps."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Wait for my shield. Do not let them separate us.
lines.ja: 俺の盾に合わせろ。連中にふたりを分断させるな。
lines.tts_text: 俺の盾に合わせろ。<short pause> 連中にふたりを分断させるな。
lines.direction: Firm, protective vanguard baritone; commanding and resolute.
lines.context: Scene 'A Roof Before Dawn'. Answering Fadyme: "The previous tenants seem reluctant to leave."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: You were very quick to decide we are a pair.
lines.ja: 私たちが二人組だと決めるの、ずいぶん早かったのね。

lines.context: Scene 'A Roof Before Dawn'. Answering Mahmut: "Wait for my shield. Do not let them separate us."

lines.en: We have been walking the same road.
lines.ja: ずっと同じ道を歩いてきただろう。
lines.tts_text: ずっと同じ道を歩いてきただろう。

lines.context: Scene 'A Roof Before Dawn'. Answering Fadyme: "You were very quick to decide we are a pair."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Then keep your place. I intend to keep mine.
lines.ja: それなら、自分の場所を守って。私は、私の場所を守るつもりよ。
lines.tts_text: それなら、自分の場所を守って。<short pause> 私は、<short pause> 私の場所を守るつもりよ。
lines.direction: Clear, determined alto; proud and unyielding partner.
lines.context: Scene 'A Roof Before Dawn'. Answering Mahmut: "We have been walking the same road."

lines.en: We did not ask for payment.
lines.ja: 礼なら要らん。報酬を求めてやったことじゃない。

lines.en: And they come? Just like that?
lines.ja: それで、本当に来てくれるの？ そんなに簡単に？

lines.en: A promise that remembers people who forget. I should like one of those.

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Mahmut. Carve it shallow. I do not stay anywhere long.

lines.en: And its healers.

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: We do not buy lies.

lines.speaker: mahmut

lines.en: I know. The forest at least whispered.

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: It remembers my name.

lines.en: We will open it.

lines.en: That bell has no rope.

lines.en: A village can survive losing a name.

lines.en: Then we give the names back.

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Every year I hid, someone else paid my hours.
lines.ja: 私が隠れていた一年ごとに、誰かが私の時間を払っていた。
lines.tts_text: <sigh> 私が隠れていた一年ごとに、誰かが私の時間を払っていた。
lines.direction: Internal monologue (close-mic inner thought): Soft, apologetic alto carrying quiet guilt. Delivered in an intimate, hushed self-reflective cadence.
lines.context: Scene 'The Empty Orchard'. Answering Mahmut: "Then we give the names back."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Who took them?
lines.ja: 誰が、その名を奪った？
lines.tts_text: 誰が、その名を奪った？
lines.direction: Watchful, serious baritone investigating the stolen village names.
lines.context: Scene 'The Empty Orchard'. Answering Nixie: "I warned them. The names are gone anyway."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: And you are?
lines.ja: ……で、あんたは？
lines.tts_text: ……で、あんたは？
lines.direction: Watchful, measured baritone sizing up a stranger who knows too much about the raiders' timing.
lines.context: Scene 'The Empty Orchard'. Answering Garrick: "Then they come through the firebreak at the second bell. They always time it to the bell."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: You did not have to follow us down here.
lines.ja: 私たちのために、こんな地下まで来てくださらなくても、よかったのに。
lines.tts_text: 私たちのために、こんな地下まで来てくださらなくても、よかったのに。
lines.direction: Gracious, warm alto speaking with sincere kindness.
lines.context: Scene 'Stairs Below the Cistern'. Answering Odelia: "The nest is behind us. The Guild ward is ahead."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: How did you find the tunnel?
lines.ja: どうやって、この地下道を見つけたんだ？
lines.tts_text: どうやって、この地下道を見つけたんだ？
lines.direction: Curious, low baritone echoing softly in the damp undercity.
lines.context: Scene 'Stairs Below the Cistern'. Answering Odelia: "Do not look for ripples. These things follow the shape of your shadow."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Tell him the elixir might work.
lines.ja: 霊薬が効くかもしれない、と伝えて。
lines.tts_text: 霊薬が効くかもしれない、と伝えて。
lines.direction: Quiet, intimate, unhurried alto.
lines.context: Scene 'The Measure of a Life'. Answering Clem: "He will ask what I told you."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: It is a small one. Let me keep it.
lines.ja: 小さな嘘よ。持たせておいて。
lines.tts_text: <breath> 小さな嘘よ。持たせておいて。
lines.direction: Urgent, vulnerable, pleading alto; dropping her aristocratic mask to beg quietly from the heart.
lines.context: Scene 'The Measure of a Life'. Answering Clem: "That is a lie."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Mahmut has already given enough years to my name.
lines.ja: マフムトはもう、私の名前のために、十分すぎる年月をくれた。
lines.tts_text: <sigh> マフムトはもう、私の名前のために、十分すぎる年月をくれた。
lines.direction: Internal monologue (close-mic inner thought): Hushed, melancholic alto carrying quiet sorrow without melodrama. Delivered in an intimate, hushed self-reflective cadence.
lines.context: Scene 'The Measure of a Life'. Answering Fadyme: "It is a small one. Let me keep it."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Mahmut. Who are you waiting for?
lines.ja: マフムトだ。……誰を待っている？
lines.tts_text: マフムトだ。<short pause> ……誰を待っている？
lines.direction: Quiet, gentle low baritone, softening for a shy young gardener who is waiting for someone.
lines.context: Scene 'The Measure of a Life'. Answering Thistle: "Y-you are waiting too. I am Thistle. I tend the bell garden at the monastery, when there is a monastery to tend."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Set it down until we have chosen the place. You do not need to hold it for us to talk.
lines.ja: 場所が決まるまで、下ろしておけ。話すのに、抱えている必要はない。
lines.tts_text: 場所が決まるまで、下ろしておけ。<short pause> 話すのに、抱えている必要はない。
lines.direction: Calm, patient baritone easing an eager young companion's need to prove himself.
lines.context: Scene 'Not All on One Shoulder'. Answering Brin: "I can keep it steady while you look."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: A useful beginning.
lines.ja: いい始まりね。
lines.tts_text: いい始まりね。
lines.direction: Warm, lightly approving alto; a small smile in the voice.
lines.context: Scene 'Not All on One Shoulder'. Answering Mahmut: "Set it down until we have chosen the place. You do not need to hold it for us to talk."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Either can work. Tell us what you need from the rest of us.
lines.ja: どちらでもいける。俺たちに何をしてほしいか、言ってくれ。
lines.tts_text: どちらでもいける。<short pause> 俺たちに何をしてほしいか、言ってくれ。
lines.direction: Calm, open baritone handing the decision to the younger companions.
lines.context: Scene 'Read the Road or Brace It'. Answering Brin: "Or we brace the narrow side. Give the people behind us a clear place to wait."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Preferably before we all volunteer for the same end of a post.
lines.ja: できれば、みんなで同じ杭の端に名乗り出る前にね。
lines.tts_text: できれば、みんなで同じ杭の端に名乗り出る前にね。
lines.direction: Wry, dry alto with gentle teasing humour.
lines.context: Scene 'Read the Road or Brace It'. Answering Mahmut: "Either can work. Tell us what you need from the rest of us."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Call before you need us to move.
lines.ja: 動いてほしい時は、その前に声をかけろ。
lines.tts_text: 動いてほしい時は、その前に声をかけろ。
lines.direction: Calm, practical baritone giving a simple field rule.
lines.context: Scene 'Read the Road or Brace It'. Answering Brin: "I will watch the space behind you."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Then neither of you has to watch everything.
lines.ja: それなら、どちらも全部を見張らなくていいわね。
lines.tts_text: それなら、どちらも全部を見張らなくていいわね。
lines.direction: Gentle, reassuring alto; relief that the burden is shared.
lines.context: Scene 'Read the Road or Brace It'. Answering Nixie: "I will check both approaches while you choose it."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Wait. We should see why it fell.
lines.ja: 待て。なぜ倒れたのか、先に確かめる。
lines.tts_text: 待て。<short pause> なぜ倒れたのか、先に確かめる。
lines.direction: Focused, low baritone; a quick stop, alert to a possible trap.
lines.context: Scene 'The Fallen Sign'. Answering Brin: "The post is loose. I can stand it up again."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: A sign that tells us to step off the path deserves a little suspicion.
lines.ja: 道を外れろと言う標識なんて、少しは疑ってかかるべきよ。
lines.tts_text: 道を外れろと言う標識なんて、少しは疑ってかかるべきよ。
lines.direction: Wry, sharp-witted alto; suspicion delivered lightly.
lines.context: Scene 'The Fallen Sign'. Answering Mahmut: "Wait. We should see why it fell."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: We clear the passage before anyone follows it.
lines.ja: 誰かが通る前に、この道を片付ける。
lines.tts_text: 誰かが通る前に、この道を片付ける。
lines.direction: Calm, resolute baritone; steady leadership.
lines.context: Scene 'The Fallen Sign'. Answering Brin: "Something is moving at the far bend."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Which place lets you share the work?
lines.ja: どこなら、役目を分け合える？
lines.tts_text: どこなら、役目を分け合える？
lines.direction: Calm, inviting baritone asking a real question, not giving an order.
lines.context: Scene 'The Footing'. Answering Nixie: "The narrow side is open from both. We can see the turn."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: We can do that.
lines.ja: それならできるわ。
lines.tts_text: それならできるわ。
lines.direction: Gentle, encouraging alto.
lines.context: Scene 'The Footing'. Answering Brin: "Either, if someone watches the side I cannot."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Both keep the road open. Choose the line you want to hold.
lines.ja: どちらでも道は開いたままだ。守りたい線を選べ。
lines.tts_text: どちらでも道は開いたままだ。<short pause> 守りたい線を選べ。
lines.direction: Calm, trusting baritone letting the young scout choose.
lines.context: Scene 'A Place to Hold'. Answering Nixie: "If we use the bank, I can watch farther across. If we use the beam, I can watch the near gap."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: A useful beam, with no volunteers underneath it.
lines.ja: 役に立つ梁ね。下敷きになる志願者もいないし。
lines.tts_text: 役に立つ梁ね。<short pause> 下敷きになる志願者もいないし。
lines.direction: Wry, amused alto with dry relief.
lines.context: Scene 'A Place to Hold'. Answering Nixie: "I will watch the gap beside it. The support behind the dead is visible from here."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Good. We move together when the line is ready.
lines.ja: よし。陣形が整ったら、一緒に動く。
lines.tts_text: よし。<short pause> 陣形が整ったら、一緒に動く。
lines.direction: Calm, approving baritone; quiet command.
lines.context: Scene 'The Other Side'. Answering Nixie: "You too."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: We can read that part without following it.
lines.ja: そこは、後を追わなくても読めるわ。
lines.tts_text: そこは、後を追わなくても読めるわ。
lines.direction: Quiet, thoughtful alto, almost to herself, reading the tracks.
lines.context: Scene 'The Turn in the Leaves'. Answering Nixie: "A dragging one. And this mark keeps going after the turn."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: What else do you hear?
lines.ja: 他に何が聞こえる？
lines.tts_text: 他に何が聞こえる？
lines.direction: Focused, low baritone; attentive and trusting the scout's ears.
lines.context: Scene 'The Turn in the Leaves'. Answering Fadyme: "We can read that part without following it."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Choose it. We stay within sight.
lines.ja: 選べ。俺たちは目の届く所にいる。
lines.tts_text: 選べ。<short pause> 俺たちは目の届く所にいる。
lines.direction: Calm, steady baritone giving permission and safety at once.
lines.context: Scene 'Two Ways to Check'. Answering Brin: "We can prepare for one first, without forgetting the other."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Then I will stay where both of you can see me.
lines.ja: なら、二人から見える場所にいるわ。
lines.tts_text: なら、二人から見える場所にいるわ。
lines.direction: Focused, composed alto; agreeing to a sensible plan.
lines.context: Scene 'Two Ways to Check'. Answering Brin: "I can hold the nearest one while you choose the attacker."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: A target to notice. Not a reason to chase without checking the lane.
lines.ja: 目をつけておく相手だ。通り道を確かめずに追う理由にはならない。
lines.tts_text: 目をつけておく相手だ。<short pause> 通り道を確かめずに追う理由にはならない。
lines.direction: Focused, measured baritone teaching restraint without scolding.
lines.context: Scene 'Two Ways to Check'. Answering Nixie: "The knock comes before the others move. We will see the bellbound one as soon as we step out."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: A map improved by having more than one pair of feet.
lines.ja: 足が一組より多いと、地図も良くなるものね。
lines.tts_text: 足が一組より多いと、地図も良くなるものね。
lines.direction: Wry, warm alto; light humour about teamwork.
lines.context: Scene 'A Mark before the Bend'. Answering Brin: "That is where someone will need it."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: We have the observation. Now we clear the passage.
lines.ja: 見るべきものは見た。次は道を片付ける。
lines.tts_text: 見るべきものは見た。<short pause> 次は道を片付ける。
lines.direction: Focused, decisive baritone moving the group on.
lines.context: Scene 'A Mark before the Bend'. Answering Fadyme: "A map improved by having more than one pair of feet."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: I will check the far side one more time.
lines.ja: 向こう側を、もう一度確かめてくる。
lines.tts_text: 向こう側を、もう一度確かめてくる。
lines.direction: Calm, careful baritone; a habit of checking twice.
lines.context: Scene 'The Sign Stands'. Answering Nixie: "And the arrow points before the turn."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: We have built a very small thing with a great deal of advice.
lines.ja: ずいぶん大勢の助言で、ずいぶん小さなものを作ったわね。
lines.tts_text: ずいぶん大勢の助言で、ずいぶん小さなものを作ったわね。
lines.direction: Wry, affectionate alto; amused at the fuss.
lines.context: Scene 'The Sign Stands'. Answering Mahmut: "I will check the far side one more time."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: The road is clear behind us.
lines.ja: 後ろの道は空いてるわ。
lines.tts_text: 後ろの道は空いてるわ。
lines.direction: Focused, clear alto reporting from the rear.
lines.context: Scene 'The Open Passage'. Answering Brin: "We have space. Keep it."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Look at their intentions before choosing the first target.
lines.ja: 最初の標的を選ぶ前に、奴らの狙いを見ろ。
lines.tts_text: 最初の標的を選ぶ前に、奴らの狙いを見ろ。
lines.direction: Focused, low baritone; tactical, quiet instruction before a fight.
lines.context: Scene 'The Open Passage'. Answering Fadyme: "The road is clear behind us."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: It stayed when you let go.
lines.ja: 手を離しても、倒れなかったな。
lines.tts_text: 手を離しても、倒れなかったな。
lines.direction: Calm, quietly pleased baritone, noticing the young builder's work.
lines.context: Scene 'A Small Thing Shared'. First line of the scene.

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: And you both told us where to stand.
lines.ja: それに、二人ともどこに立てばいいか教えてくれたわ。
lines.tts_text: それに、二人ともどこに立てばいいか教えてくれたわ。
lines.direction: Gentle, grateful alto giving credit.
lines.context: Scene 'A Small Thing Shared'. Answering Brin: "You watched the side I could not."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: An arrow with a second opinion. We should keep the idea.
lines.ja: 二人目の意見つきの矢印ね。この考えは、取っておきましょう。
lines.tts_text: 二人目の意見つきの矢印ね。<short pause> この考えは、取っておきましょう。
lines.direction: Wry, pleased alto; teasing but sincere.
lines.context: Scene 'A Small Thing Shared'. Answering Nixie: "After you looked."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: We can use it at the next turn.
lines.ja: 次の曲がり角でも使える。
lines.tts_text: 次の曲がり角でも使える。
lines.direction: Calm, approving baritone.
lines.context: Scene 'A Small Thing Shared'. Answering Fadyme: "An arrow with a second opinion. We should keep the idea."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Good. I was beginning to think the sign might join the company.
lines.ja: よかった。あの標識まで仲間に加わるのかと、思い始めてたところよ。
lines.tts_text: よかった。<short pause> あの標識まで仲間に加わるのかと、思い始めてたところよ。
lines.direction: Wry, playful alto with a soft laugh behind it.
lines.context: Scene 'A Road Left Open'. Answering Brin: "Ready."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: It has a place to stay.
lines.ja: あれには、居場所ができた。
lines.tts_text: あれには、居場所ができた。
lines.direction: Calm, warm low baritone; a small, meaningful remark.
lines.context: Scene 'A Road Left Open'. Answering Fadyme: "Good. I was beginning to think the sign might join the company."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: That is a useful kind of answer.
lines.ja: それは、役に立つ答えね。
lines.tts_text: それは、役に立つ答えね。
lines.direction: Gentle, appreciative alto.
lines.context: Scene 'One More Look'. Answering Brin: "They could see it."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: We should continue before the road grows busy.
lines.ja: 道が混む前に、先へ進もう。
lines.tts_text: 道が混む前に、先へ進もう。
lines.direction: Focused, practical baritone.
lines.context: Scene 'One More Look'. Answering Fadyme: "That is a useful kind of answer."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: The shrine keeper can help you with the register. We are clearing the road.
lines.ja: 名簿のことは、祠の番人が手伝ってくれる。俺たちは、道を片付けているところだ。
lines.tts_text: 名簿のことは、祠の番人が手伝ってくれる。<short pause> 俺たちは、道を片付けているところだ。
lines.direction: Calm, courteous baritone to a passing traveler; polite but busy.
lines.context: Scene 'The Last Traveler'. Answering Traveler: "Do you need my name for the register?"

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: A sensible place to stop.
lines.ja: 立ち寄るには、いい場所ね。
lines.tts_text: 立ち寄るには、いい場所ね。
lines.direction: Gentle, kind alto to a traveler.
lines.context: Scene 'The Last Traveler'. Answering Traveler: "Then I will give it there."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: You can sit before deciding how loud to be.
lines.ja: どれくらい賑やかにするかは、座ってから決めればいいわ。
lines.tts_text: どれくらい賑やかにするかは、座ってから決めればいいわ。
lines.direction: Gentle, welcoming alto putting a shy guest at ease.
lines.context: Scene 'An Empty Place'. Answering Nixie: "That is Jori's highest recommendation."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: There is room to pass behind the chair.
lines.ja: 椅子の後ろなら、通れる隙間がある。
lines.tts_text: 椅子の後ろなら、通れる隙間がある。
lines.direction: Calm, quiet baritone; practical kindness.
lines.context: Scene 'An Empty Place'. Answering Fadyme: "You can sit before deciding how loud to be."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: A decisive answer.
lines.ja: きっぱりした答えね。
lines.tts_text: きっぱりした答えね。
lines.direction: Wry, amused alto.
lines.context: Scene 'An Empty Place'. Answering Guest: "This one is a very good chair."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: I will sit here for a moment.
lines.ja: 少しだけ、ここに座らせてもらうわ。
lines.tts_text: 少しだけ、ここに座らせてもらうわ。
lines.direction: Gentle, slightly tired alto, accepting rest.
lines.context: Scene 'An Empty Place'. Answering Fadyme: "A decisive answer."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: I know. I would like to.
lines.ja: わかってる。そうしたいの。
lines.tts_text: わかってる。<short pause> そうしたいの。
lines.direction: Calm, soft alto; a sincere small choice.
lines.context: Scene 'An Empty Place'. Answering Guest: "You do not have to."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: I will bring the bread within reach.
lines.ja: パンを、手の届く所に持ってくる。
lines.tts_text: パンを、手の届く所に持ってくる。
lines.direction: Calm, caring baritone; quiet care in a simple act.
lines.context: Scene 'An Empty Place'. Answering Fadyme: "I know. I would like to."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: It is a good place to listen.
lines.ja: 耳を傾けるには、いい場所ね。
lines.tts_text: 耳を傾けるには、いい場所ね。
lines.direction: Gentle, hushed alto.
lines.context: Scene 'A Place beside the Noise'. Answering Guest: "I thought I might listen from here."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Nobody needs to move closer.
lines.ja: 誰も、近づく必要はない。
lines.tts_text: 誰も、近づく必要はない。
lines.direction: Calm, soft baritone making room for a timid guest.
lines.context: Scene 'A Place beside the Noise'. Answering Fadyme: "It is a good place to listen."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: You may share the credit with the soup.
lines.ja: 手柄は、スープと山分けしてもいいわよ。
lines.tts_text: 手柄は、スープと山分けしてもいいわよ。
lines.direction: Wry, playful alto teasing a proud cook.
lines.context: Scene 'After the Last Verse'. Answering Kera: "That is not solely the table's achievement."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: We should help put these away.
lines.ja: 片付けを、手伝うとしよう。
lines.tts_text: 片付けを、手伝うとしよう。
lines.direction: Quiet, warm baritone after a good evening.
lines.context: Scene 'After the Last Verse'. Answering Fadyme: "You may share the credit with the soup."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: A table for everyone. A pot for the very brave.
lines.ja: 食卓は、みんなのために。鍋は、よほど勇敢な人のために。
lines.tts_text: 食卓は、みんなのために。<short pause> 鍋は、よほど勇敢な人のために。
lines.direction: Wry, merry alto with a smile.
lines.context: Scene 'A Table for Tomorrow'. Answering Kera: "I may revise my contribution."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Come on. Before she explains the recipe.
lines.ja: 行くぞ。あいつが作り方を説明し始める前にな。
lines.tts_text: <chuckle> 行くぞ。あいつが作り方を説明し始める前にな。
lines.direction: Calm, dry baritone with a rare hint of humour.
lines.context: Scene 'A Table for Tomorrow'. Answering Fadyme: "A table for everyone. A pot for the very brave."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: That is generous.
lines.ja: ……なんて、気前がいいの。
lines.tts_text: <breath> ……なんて、気前がいいの。
lines.direction: Touched, softened alto; genuinely moved by kindness.
lines.context: Scene 'The Inn Meal'. Answering Innkeeper: "After Crownfall, travelers stopped paying. So we stopped charging. Twice a day, a meal, no coin."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: So the meal is a count.
lines.ja: つまり、食事は数え上げでもある、というわけか。
lines.tts_text: つまり、食事は数え上げでもある、というわけか。
lines.direction: Observant, thoughtful baritone, realising the practical purpose.
lines.context: Scene 'The Inn Meal'. Answering Innkeeper: "It is practical. A fed traveler says their name at the door. A hungry one slips past the register."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: The bell cannot count a square this loud. For one night, it is losing.
lines.ja: これだけ賑やかな広場は、鐘にも数えきれない。今夜だけは、鐘の負けね。
lines.tts_text: これだけ賑やかな広場は、鐘にも数えきれない。<short pause> 今夜だけは、鐘の負けね。
lines.direction: Content, warm inner alto; a rare moment of peace inside the noise.
lines.context: Scene 'Last Song'. Answering Pippa: "Last verse! Everyone who brought a name, sing it with me!"

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: Beyond the firelight, a single cracked bell rang, then went still.
lines.ja: 焚き火の明かりの向こうで、ひび割れた鐘が一度だけ鳴り、そして静まった。
lines.tts_text: <breath> 焚き火の明かりの向こうで、ひび割れた鐘が一度だけ鳴り、そして静まった。
lines.direction: Hushed, eerie nocturnal chronicle narrator; taut stillness in the dark forest beyond the campfire.
lines.context: Scene 'Ash That Falls Upward'. Answering Nixie: "No. Listen. They are whispering someone else's name now."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Her.
lines.ja: ……あいつだ。
lines.tts_text: <breath> ……あいつだ。
lines.direction: Low, hard, grim baritone; recognizing the Bell-Widow's bell in the dark.
lines.context: Scene 'Ash That Falls Upward'. Answering Narration: "Beyond the firelight, a single cracked bell rang, then went still."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: She is not coming closer. She wants us to know she is there.
lines.ja: 近づいては来ない。そこにいると、私たちに知らせたいだけ。
lines.tts_text: 近づいては来ない。そこにいると、私たちに知らせたいだけ。
lines.direction: Steady, grounded, unwavering alto.
lines.context: Scene 'Ash That Falls Upward'. Answering Mahmut: "Her."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: The widow's bell. It rang like that the night Mother's portrait came down.
lines.ja: 鐘の未亡人。お母様の肖像画が外された夜も、あんなふうに鳴った。
lines.tts_text: <breath> 鐘の未亡人。お母様の肖像画が外された夜も、あんなふうに鳴った。
lines.direction: Internal monologue (close-mic inner thought): Shaken, hushed alto after a chilling revelation. Delivered in an intimate, hushed self-reflective cadence.
lines.context: Scene 'Ash That Falls Upward'. Answering Fadyme: "She is not coming closer. She wants us to know she is there."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Sleep. I will watch.
lines.ja: 眠れ。見張りは俺が立つ。
lines.tts_text: <breath> 眠れ。見張りは俺が立つ。
lines.direction: Warm, protective nocturnal baritone; quiet and steady beside the campfire.
lines.context: Scene 'Ash That Falls Upward'. Answering Fadyme (thought): "The widow's bell. It rang like that the night Mother's portrait came down."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: You always say that. One day I will watch, and you will sleep.
lines.ja: いつもそう言うのね。いつか私が見張って、あなたが眠る日が来るわ。
lines.tts_text: いつもそう言うのね。いつか私が見張って、あなたが眠る日が来るわ。
lines.direction: Light, conversational alto with effortless charm.
lines.context: Scene 'Ash That Falls Upward'. Answering Mahmut: "Sleep. I will watch."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: You knew her.
lines.ja: あの人を、知っていたのね。
lines.tts_text: あの人を、知っていたのね。
lines.direction: Quiet, intimate, unhurried alto.
lines.context: Scene 'What We Did Not Say'. First line of the scene.

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Yes.
lines.ja: ……ああ。知っていた。
lines.tts_text: <sigh> ……ああ。知っていた。
lines.direction: Low, quiet admission in the dark; dropping his guard with honest regret.
lines.context: Scene 'What We Did Not Say'. Answering Fadyme: "You knew her."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: You said no. In the rain. You said it very fast.
lines.ja: 知らないって言った。雨の中で。とても早口で。
lines.tts_text: 知らないって言った。雨の中で。とても早口で。
lines.direction: Steady, grounded, unwavering alto.
lines.context: Scene 'What We Did Not Say'. Answering Mahmut: "Yes."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: I thought if you did not know her, she could not frighten you.
lines.ja: お前があいつのことを知らなければ…… 怯えずに済むと思ったんだ。
lines.tts_text: <breath> お前があいつのことを知らなければ…… <sigh> 怯えずに済むと思ったんだ。
lines.direction: Ashamed, vulnerable baritone; a clumsy, heartfelt confession of a knight who only wanted to shield her from fear.
lines.context: Scene 'What We Did Not Say'. Answering Fadyme: "You said no. In the rain. You said it very fast."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: That is a very foolish reason.
lines.ja: ずいぶん、愚かな理由ね。
lines.tts_text: <breath> ずいぶん、愚かな理由ね。
lines.direction: Soft, gentle alto near a whisper.
lines.context: Scene 'What We Did Not Say'. Answering Mahmut: "I thought if you did not know her, she could not frighten you."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: And it is mine too. I cannot scold him without scolding myself.
lines.ja: そしてそれは、私の理由でもある。彼を叱れば、自分を叱ることになる。
lines.tts_text: <sigh> そしてそれは、私の理由でもある。彼を叱れば、自分を叱ることになる。
lines.direction: Hushed, remorseful inner alto weighed down by the hope she asked him to carry.
lines.context: Scene 'What We Did Not Say'. Answering Fadyme: "That is a very foolish reason."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Tell me the rest when you can. I will not ask tonight.
lines.ja: 話せるときに、残りを聞かせて。今夜は聞かないから。
lines.tts_text: 話せるときに、残りを聞かせて。今夜は聞かないから。
lines.direction: Soft, soothing, compassionate alto; unhurried and kind.
lines.context: Scene 'What We Did Not Say'. Answering Fadyme (thought): "And it is mine too. I cannot scold him without scolding myself."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: That is a kinder bargain than I deserve.
lines.ja: ……俺には、もったいないほど優しい取引だな。
lines.tts_text: <exhales> ……俺には、もったいないほど優しい取引だな。
lines.direction: Tired, deeply grateful, warm low baritone; touched by Fadyme's forgiveness.
lines.context: Scene 'What We Did Not Say'. Answering Fadyme: "Tell me the rest when you can. I will not ask tonight."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: I prayed there once. I was small enough to hide under the pews.
lines.ja: 昔、あそこで祈ったことがあるの。長椅子の下に隠れられるくらい、小さかった頃。
lines.tts_text: <breath> 昔、あそこで祈ったことがあるの。長椅子の下に隠れられるくらい、小さかった頃。
lines.direction: Nostalgic, softly aching alto remembering what was lost.
lines.context: Scene 'The Tower Across the Fields'. Answering Nixie: "Cathedral by noon if the fields do not eat our boots."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: You never told me.
lines.ja: ……そんな話は、一度も聞かなかったな。
lines.tts_text: <breath> ……そんな話は、一度も聞かなかったな。
lines.direction: Gentle, wistful low baritone; realizing how much of Fadyme's childhood she kept hidden.
lines.context: Scene 'The Tower Across the Fields'. Answering Fadyme: "I prayed there once. I was small enough to hide under the pews."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: I am telling you now. See? I tell you things.
lines.ja: 今、話しているでしょう？ ほら。ちゃんと話すのよ、私。
lines.tts_text: 今、話しているでしょう？ ほら。ちゃんと話すのよ、私。
lines.direction: Dry, perceptive alto with a subtle ironic smile.
lines.context: Scene 'The Tower Across the Fields'. Answering Mahmut: "You never told me."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Small things. Only small things.
lines.ja: 小さなことだけ。小さなことだけを。
lines.tts_text: <sigh> 小さなことだけ。小さなことだけを。
lines.direction: Hushed, remorseful inner alto weighed down by the hope she asked him to carry.
lines.context: Scene 'The Tower Across the Fields'. Answering Fadyme: "I am telling you now. See? I tell you things."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: A healer first. Please.
lines.ja: まず、治療師を。お願い。
lines.tts_text: まず、治療師を。お願い。
lines.direction: Firm, decisive, noble alto refusing to yield a single companion's name.
lines.context: Scene 'The Sealed Order'. Answering Kera: "We should open it. Knowledge is the only antidote I trust."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Because whatever it says, someone at the table may need one afterward.
lines.ja: 何が書いてあっても、そのあと、この席の誰かに治療師が要るかもしれないから。
lines.tts_text: 何が書いてあっても、そのあと、この席の誰かに治療師が要るかもしれないから。
lines.direction: Quiet, intimate, unhurried alto.
lines.context: Scene 'The Sealed Order'. Answering Jori: "Why does a healer matter for paper?"

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Then we go down.
lines.ja: なら、地下へ降りよう。
lines.tts_text: なら、地下へ降りよう。
lines.direction: Decisive, grounded baritone setting the course for the Undercity.
lines.context: Scene 'The Sealed Order'. Answering Kera: "...The Undercity has the best healers. And the Guild ledger."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: We will stop at the next wall.
lines.ja: 次の石垣のところで、少し休もう。
lines.tts_text: 次の石垣のところで、少し休もう。
lines.direction: Casual, unforced baritone; pretending he wants to stop so Fadyme can catch her breath without pride being hurt.
lines.context: Scene 'Orchard Country'. First line of the scene.

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: You stopped at the last wall. And the one before.
lines.ja: 前の塀でも止まったわ。その前の塀でも。
lines.tts_text: 前の塀でも止まったわ。その前の塀でも。
lines.direction: Understated, dryly observant alto; crisp and unhurried.
lines.context: Scene 'Orchard Country'. Answering Mahmut: "We will stop at the next wall."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: They were good walls.
lines.ja: ……どれも、いい石垣だったからな。
lines.tts_text: <exhales> ……どれも、いい石垣だったからな。
lines.direction: Deadpan, affectionate dry humor; keeping up the gentle excuse for stopping at every wall.
lines.context: Scene 'Orchard Country'. Answering Fadyme: "You stopped at the last wall. And the one before."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: You are pacing yourself for me.
lines.ja: 私に合わせて歩いてくれているのね。
lines.tts_text: 私に合わせて歩いてくれているのね。
lines.direction: Perceptive, quietly knowing alto; seeing through Mahmut's gentle excuses with fond understanding.
lines.context: Scene 'Orchard Country'. Answering Mahmut: "They were good walls."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: I am pacing myself for the walls.
lines.ja: 石垣のために、歩調を合わせているだけだ。
lines.tts_text: <chuckle> 石垣のために、歩調を合わせているだけだ。
lines.direction: Warm, deadpan fondness; a quiet smile in his voice as he matches her slower steps.
lines.context: Scene 'Orchard Country'. Answering Fadyme: "You are pacing yourself for me."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: She laughed, and then coughed, and turned her face into her scarf before he could see.
lines.ja: 彼女は笑い、それから咳き込み、彼に見られる前に襟巻きへと顔を埋めた。
lines.tts_text: <breath> 彼女は笑い、それから咳き込み、<sigh> 彼に見られる前に襟巻きへと顔を埋めた。
lines.direction: Quietly heartbreaking, intimate chronicle narration; gentle warmth on 'she laughed', darkening into hushed sorrow as she hides her cough in her scarf.
lines.context: Scene 'Orchard Country'. Answering Mahmut: "I am pacing myself for the walls."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: You are smiling.
lines.ja: ……笑っているな。
lines.tts_text: <breath> ……笑っているな。
lines.direction: Softly surprised, warm baritone; relieved to see Fadyme smiling in the sunlight.
lines.context: Scene 'Up Into the Light'. First line of the scene.

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: The sun is warm. I had forgotten it was allowed to be.
lines.ja: お日様が温かいの。温かくていいんだって、忘れていたわ。
lines.tts_text: <breath> お日様が温かいの。温かくていいんだって、忘れていたわ。
lines.direction: Soft, gentle alto near a whisper.
lines.context: Scene 'Up Into the Light'. Answering Mahmut: "You are smiling."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: The elixir. Did Kera say when?
lines.ja: 例の霊薬か。……ケラは、いつ頃になると？
lines.tts_text: <breath> 例の霊薬か。……ケラは、いつ頃になると？
lines.direction: Quietly hopeful baritone; clinging to the small lie that Kera's elixir might cure her.
lines.context: Scene 'Up Into the Light'. Answering Fadyme: "The sun is warm. I had forgotten it was allowed to be."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Soon. She is very good at soon.
lines.ja: もうすぐよ。ケラは『もうすぐ』がとても得意なの。
lines.tts_text: もうすぐよ。ケラは『もうすぐ』がとても得意なの。
lines.direction: Steady, grounded, unwavering alto.
lines.context: Scene 'Up Into the Light'. Answering Mahmut: "The elixir. Did Kera say when?"

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Weeks. I will spend some of them standing in the sun. That much I can choose.
lines.ja: 数週間。そのいくらかは、日なたに立って過ごそう。それくらいは、私が選べる。
lines.tts_text: <breath> 数週間。そのいくらかは、日なたに立って過ごそう。それくらいは、私が選べる。
lines.direction: Bittersweet, tender inner alto; caught between love for her companions and the shortness of her remaining days.
lines.context: Scene 'Up Into the Light'. Answering Fadyme: "Soon. She is very good at soon."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: East, then. The altar road crosses the ravine.
lines.ja: なら、東へ向かおう。祭壇への道は、渓谷を越える。
lines.tts_text: なら、東へ向かおう。祭壇への道は、渓谷を越える。
lines.direction: Resolved, steady baritone with renewed purpose.
lines.context: Scene 'Up Into the Light'. Answering Fadyme (thought): "Weeks. I will spend some of them standing in the sun. That much I can choose."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: You have not spoken since the span.
lines.ja: 橋を渡ってから、ひと言も話していないわね。
lines.tts_text: 橋を渡ってから、ひと言も話していないわね。
lines.direction: Soft, soothing, compassionate alto; unhurried and kind.
lines.context: Scene 'Watch Kept'. First line of the scene.

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: He taught me to hold a shield. He signed the order that made me drop it.
lines.ja: あの人が、俺に盾の構え方を教えた。……そして、俺にその盾を捨てさせた命令書に署名した。
lines.tts_text: <sigh> あの人が、俺に盾の構え方を教えた。……そして、俺にその盾を捨てさせた命令書に署名した。
lines.direction: Hollow, quietly devastated baritone by the campfire; speaking of the mentor who betrayed everything he taught.
lines.context: Scene 'Watch Kept'. Answering Fadyme: "You have not spoken since the span."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: And tonight he held a bridge.
lines.ja: そして今夜、あの人は橋を守った。
lines.tts_text: <breath> そして今夜、あの人は橋を守った。
lines.direction: Soft, gentle alto near a whisper.
lines.context: Scene 'Watch Kept'. Answering Mahmut: "He taught me to hold a shield. He signed the order that made me drop it."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Does that make him better or worse?
lines.ja: ……それで、あの人はマシになったのか？ それとも、もっとタチが悪いのか？
lines.tts_text: <breath> ……それで、あの人はマシになったのか？ それとも、もっとタチが悪いのか？
lines.direction: Raw, conflicted, unguarded baritone; asking Fadyme a question he cannot answer himself.
lines.context: Scene 'Watch Kept'. Answering Fadyme: "And tonight he held a bridge."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: It makes him a man who was late. You know how that feels.
lines.ja: 遅れてきた人、ということよ。その気持ちは、あなたも知っているでしょう？
lines.tts_text: 遅れてきた人、ということよ。その気持ちは、あなたも知っているでしょう？
lines.direction: Quiet, intimate, unhurried alto.
lines.context: Scene 'Watch Kept'. Answering Mahmut: "Does that make him better or worse?"

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: For once, she kept watch, and he slept.
lines.ja: この夜ばかりは、彼女が見張りに立ち、彼が眠りについた。
lines.tts_text: <breath> この夜ばかりは、彼女が見張りに立ち、彼が眠りについた。
lines.direction: Deeply tender, peaceful nocturnal narration; soft warmth as Fadyme finally keeps watch while the exhausted knight sleeps.
lines.context: Scene 'Watch Kept'. Answering Fadyme: "It makes him a man who was late. You know how that feels."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Whose soldiers?
lines.ja: どこの兵だ？
lines.tts_text: どこの兵だ？
lines.direction: Hard, alert baritone spotting armed figures in the fog.
lines.context: Scene 'Fog in the Ravine'. Answering Refugee: "Do not cross the old bridge. Soldiers on it. Crown colors, upside down."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Then she had better keep her hood up.
lines.ja: なら、その人はフードを下ろさないほうがいいわね。
lines.tts_text: なら、その人はフードを下ろさないほうがいいわね。
lines.direction: Dry, perceptive alto with a subtle ironic smile.
lines.context: Scene 'Fog in the Ravine'. Answering Refugee: "A marshal's. They are looking for a woman with a bell pin."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Crown colors, upside down. Oren always hated sloppy banners.
lines.ja: 逆さに掲げられた王冠の旗……。オレンは昔から、だらしない軍旗を嫌っていたな。
lines.tts_text: <breath> 逆さに掲げられた王冠の旗……。オレンは昔から、だらしない軍旗を嫌っていたな。
lines.direction: Internal monologue in a grim, hushed baritone; recognizing his old commander's signal.
lines.context: Scene 'Fog in the Ravine'. Answering Fadyme: "Then she had better keep her hood up."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: I will be the most careful person on any stair.
lines.ja: どの階段でも、いちばん慎重な人になるわ。
lines.tts_text: どの階段でも、いちばん慎重な人になるわ。
lines.direction: Gentle, understated alto with a faint, warm smile.
lines.context: Scene 'Separate Roads'. Answering Hana: "Fadyme. I am still not telling. But please be careful on the stairs."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: We meet at the altar. All of us.
lines.ja: 祭壇で落ち合おう。全員でだ。
lines.tts_text: 祭壇で落ち合おう。全員でだ。
lines.direction: Resolved, steady leadership baritone uniting the company before the final ascent.
lines.context: Scene 'Separate Roads'. Answering Fadyme: "I will be the most careful person on any stair."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: A signal.
lines.ja: ……合図だ。
lines.tts_text: <breath> ……合図だ。
lines.direction: Alert, hushed baritone spotting the lantern signal ahead.
lines.context: Scene 'The Estate Road'. First line of the scene.

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Sable. She said she would open a door from inside.
lines.ja: セーブルよ。中から扉を開けるって言っていたわ。
lines.tts_text: <exhales> セーブルよ。中から扉を開けるって言っていたわ。
lines.direction: Soft, relieved alto exhale; letting go of tension beside the people she trusts.
lines.context: Scene 'The Estate Road'. Answering Mahmut: "A signal."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: You trust her.
lines.ja: ……あいつを信じるのか。
lines.tts_text: <breath> ……あいつを信じるのか。
lines.direction: Searching, quiet baritone asking if Fadyme truly trusts Sable.
lines.context: Scene 'The Estate Road'. Answering Fadyme: "Sable. She said she would open a door from inside."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: She opens doors for others and never walks through first. People like that keep their word.
lines.ja: あの人は誰かのために扉を開けて、自分が先に通ることはしない。そういう人は、約束を守るわ。
lines.tts_text: あの人は誰かのために扉を開けて、自分が先に通ることはしない。そういう人は、約束を守るわ。
lines.direction: Observant, insightful alto; calm and attentive.
lines.context: Scene 'The Estate Road'. Answering Mahmut: "You trust her."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Gray wax on the milestone, still soft. She passed here this morning. She is ahead of us.
lines.ja: 里程標に灰色の蝋。まだ柔らかい。今朝ここを通ったのね。あの人は、私たちより先にいる。
lines.tts_text: 里程標に灰色の蝋。まだ柔らかい。今朝ここを通ったのね。あの人は、私たちより先にいる。
lines.direction: Guarded, uneasy alto sensing the bell's resonance in the mist.
lines.context: Scene 'The Estate Road'. Answering Fadyme: "She opens doors for others and never walks through first. People like that keep their word."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Then she reaches the altar before we do.
lines.ja: なら、あいつは俺たちより先に祭壇へ着く。
lines.tts_text: なら、あいつは俺たちより先に祭壇へ着く。
lines.direction: Grim, urgent baritone realizing the enemy is half a day ahead on the altar road.
lines.context: Scene 'The Estate Road'. Answering Fadyme: "Gray wax on the milestone, still soft. She passed here this morning. She is ahead of us."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: It is beautiful. That is the worst part.
lines.ja: きれいね。それが、いちばん残酷なところ。
lines.tts_text: きれいね。それが、いちばん残酷なところ。
lines.direction: Quiet, intimate, unhurried alto.
lines.context: Scene 'The Crown-Shaped Crater'. First line of the scene.

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: When this is done, we will find somewhere ugly and safe.
lines.ja: これが全部終わったら……どこか無骨で、安全な場所を見つけよう。
lines.tts_text: <exhales> これが全部終わったら……どこか無骨で、安全な場所を見つけよう。
lines.direction: Dry, warm, wistful baritone dreaming of an ordinary life after the altar.
lines.context: Scene 'The Crown-Shaped Crater'. Answering Fadyme: "It is beautiful. That is the worst part."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: With cheese.
lines.ja: チーズ付きでね。
lines.tts_text: <breath> チーズ付きでね。
lines.direction: Bright, sunlit, peacefully smiling alto; savoring a rare moment of warmth.
lines.context: Scene 'The Crown-Shaped Crater'. Answering Mahmut: "When this is done, we will find somewhere ugly and safe."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: With cheese.
lines.ja: ……ああ。チーズ付きでな。
lines.tts_text: <chuckle> ……ああ。チーズ付きでな。
lines.direction: Gentle, fond baritone with a quiet smile, echoing their shared joke.
lines.context: Scene 'The Crown-Shaped Crater'. Answering Fadyme: "With cheese."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: He believes the machine is the curse. Tomorrow he learns it is only the hand that holds the pen.
lines.ja: 彼は、あの機械が呪いだと思っている。明日、それはペンを握る手にすぎないと知ることになる。
lines.tts_text: <sigh> 彼は、あの機械が呪いだと思っている。明日、それはペンを握る手にすぎないと知ることになる。
lines.direction: Internal monologue (close-mic inner thought): Hushed, melancholic alto carrying quiet sorrow without melodrama. Delivered in an intimate, hushed self-reflective cadence.
lines.context: Scene 'The Crown-Shaped Crater'. Answering Mahmut: "With cheese."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: Below them, at the foot of the stair, a small lantern light moved. Their friends were already there.
lines.ja: 眼下の階段の麓で、小さな角灯の明かりが揺れていた。仲間たちは、すでにそこで待っていた。
lines.tts_text: <breath> 眼下の階段の麓で、小さな角灯の明かりが揺れていた。仲間たちは、すでにそこで待っていた。
lines.direction: Warm, quietly hopeful chronicle narration; a gentle lift in the voice as lantern light reveals their loyal companions waiting below.
lines.context: Scene 'The Crown-Shaped Crater'. Answering Fadyme (thought): "He believes the machine is the curse. Tomorrow he learns it is only the hand that holds the pen."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: If I wake before the bell tomorrow, I will call it luck. If I do not... Mahmut must never read this page.
lines.ja: 明日、鐘より先に目が覚めたなら……運が良かったと思うことにする。もし覚めなかったら……マフムトには、このページを決して読ませない。
lines.tts_text: <breath> 明日、鐘より先に目が覚めたなら……運が良かったと思うことにする。もし覚めなかったら……マフムトには、このページを決して読ませない。
lines.direction: Hushed, trembling, vulnerable inner alto; speaking quietly to herself at night with genuine fear beneath her poise.
lines.context: Scene 'A Letter the Rain Could Not Keep'. First line of the scene.

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: One month, perhaps less. The old physician wrote it in Mother's prayer book. The ink does not tremble. I do.
lines.ja: 一か月。もっと短いかもしれない。老医師は、お母様の祈祷書にそう書いた。インクは震えていない。震えているのは、私。
lines.tts_text: <sigh> 一か月。もっと短いかもしれない。老医師は、お母様の祈祷書にそう書いた。インクは震えていない。震えているのは、私。
lines.direction: Internal monologue (close-mic inner thought): Fragile, emotionally breaking alto; voice trembling slightly at the edges while trying to hold her composure together. Delivered in an intimate, hushed self-reflective cadence.
lines.context: Scene 'A Letter the Rain Could Not Keep'. Answering Fadyme (thought): "If I wake before the bell tomorrow, I will call it luck. If I do not... Mahmut must never read this page."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: You missed supper. I saved the part that did not burn.
lines.ja: 夕餉を抜いただろう。焦げなかった分を、取っておいた。
lines.tts_text: <breath> 夕餉を抜いただろう。焦げなかった分を、取っておいた。
lines.direction: Gentle, understated, caring low baritone; a quiet knight offering saved bread by the fire without making a fuss.
lines.context: Scene 'A Letter the Rain Could Not Keep'. Answering Fadyme (thought): "One month, perhaps less. The old physician wrote it in Mother's prayer book. The ink does not tremble. I do."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Then it is a feast. I am perfectly fine.
lines.ja: なら、ごちそうね。私は、まったく平気よ。
lines.tts_text: なら、ごちそうね。私は、まったく平気よ。
lines.direction: Poised young woman putting on a brave, gentle smile ('I am perfectly fine') while subtly hiding exhaustion and chill beneath her warm, composed alto.
lines.context: Scene 'A Letter the Rain Could Not Keep'. Answering Mahmut: "You missed supper. I saved the part that did not burn."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Your hand is shaking.
lines.ja: ……手が、震えているぞ。
lines.tts_text: <breath> ……手が、震えているぞ。
lines.direction: Quiet, attentive concern in a low baritone; noticing her trembling fingers in the cold.
lines.context: Scene 'A Letter the Rain Could Not Keep'. Answering Fadyme: "Then it is a feast. I am perfectly fine."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: The cold has found my fingers. It has not found the rest of me.
lines.ja: 寒さが、指先を見つけただけ。ほかのところまでは、見つけられていないわ。
lines.tts_text: 寒さが、指先を見つけただけ。ほかのところまでは、見つけられていないわ。
lines.direction: Poised, graceful alto deflecting concern with dry, effortless elegance.
lines.context: Scene 'A Letter the Rain Could Not Keep'. Answering Mahmut: "Your hand is shaking."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: She hides the red stain beneath her cuff. He offers his cloak. She takes it, and lets him believe the warmth helped.
lines.ja: 彼女は袖口の下に赤い染みを隠す。彼は無言で外套を差し出した。彼女はそれを受け取り、ぬくもりが効いたのだと彼に思わせておいた。
lines.tts_text: <breath> 彼女は袖口の下に赤い染みを隠す。彼は無言で外套を差し出した。彼女はそれを受け取り、ぬくもりが効いたのだと彼に思わせておいた。
lines.direction: Deep, sorrowful, intimate chronicle narrator; hushed and tender, conveying unspoken heartbreak as she hides her coughed blood beneath her cuff.
lines.context: Scene 'A Letter the Rain Could Not Keep'. Answering Fadyme: "The cold has found my fingers. It has not found the rest of me."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: You will not take her anywhere.
lines.ja: お前には、指一本触れさせん。どこへも連れて行かせはしない。
lines.tts_text: お前には、指一本触れさせん。どこへも連れて行かせはしない。
lines.direction: Low, dangerous, unyielding protective baritone; stepping between Fadyme and the Bell-Widow with shield raised.
lines.context: Scene 'A Letter the Rain Could Not Keep'. Answering Yseldra: "Princess. The road ends at the altar. Give me the last hour before it takes you."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Then it can choose someone who is not under my shield.
lines.ja: なら、俺の盾の後ろにいない者を、勝手に選ぶがいい。
lines.tts_text: なら、俺の盾の後ろにいない者を、勝手に選ぶがいい。
lines.direction: Defiant, iron-willed knight baritone; challenging fate itself without raising his voice into a shout.
lines.context: Scene 'A Letter the Rain Could Not Keep'. Answering Yseldra: "I came to stop the bell, not to kill its prisoner. You cannot guard a door that has already chosen its offering."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Do you know her?
lines.ja: あの人を、知っているの？
lines.tts_text: あの人を、知っているの？
lines.direction: Poised, luminous gothic alto; unhurried cadence with quiet dignity and natural breath.
lines.context: Scene 'A Letter the Rain Could Not Keep'. Answering Mahmut: "Then it can choose someone who is not under my shield."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: No.
lines.ja: ……いや。知らん。
lines.tts_text: <breath> ……いや。知らん。
lines.direction: Slightly too-quick, guarded baritone; a protective lie spoken hurriedly in the rain to spare Fadyme fear.
lines.context: Scene 'A Letter the Rain Could Not Keep'. Answering Fadyme: "Do you know her?"

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: I know the bell she carries. And I know what it means when it rings for me.
lines.ja: あの人が持つ鐘なら知っている。それが私のために鳴るとき、何を意味するのかも。
lines.tts_text: <sigh> あの人が持つ鐘なら知っている。それが私のために鳴るとき、何を意味するのかも。
lines.direction: Internal monologue (close-mic inner thought): Hushed, melancholic alto carrying quiet sorrow without melodrama. Delivered in an intimate, hushed self-reflective cadence.
lines.context: Scene 'A Letter the Rain Could Not Keep'. Answering Mahmut: "No."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: Yseldra leaves a seven-notched gray seal on Mahmut’s shield. Fadyme turns away before he can see that she is crying.
lines.ja: イゼルドラはマフムトの盾に、七つの刻み目がある灰色の封印を残して去った。ファディメは、涙を彼に見られぬよう顔を背けた。
lines.tts_text: <breath> イゼルドラはマフムトの盾に、七つの刻み目がある灰色の封印を残して去った。<sigh> ファディメは、涙を彼に見られぬよう顔を背けた。
lines.direction: Solemn, grave gothic chronicle narrator; resonant low bass on the seven-notched seal, softening into quiet grief as Fadyme hides her tears.
lines.context: Scene 'A Letter the Rain Could Not Keep'. Answering Yseldra: "When the names begin to vanish, remember: I warned you."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Show yourself.
lines.ja: 姿を現せ！
lines.tts_text: 姿を現せ！
lines.direction: Low, dangerous warning baritone drawing his blade as footsteps echo on the altar stairs.
lines.context: Scene 'The Hour That Remained'. Answering Cael: "You have finally told him the truth. How considerate of you to wait until the hour was nearly gone."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Uncle.
lines.ja: ……叔父様。
lines.tts_text: <sigh> ……叔父様。
lines.direction: Fragile, emotionally breaking alto; voice trembling slightly at the edges while trying to hold her composure together.
lines.context: Scene 'The Hour That Remained'. Answering Cael: "Lord Cael Veyr. The Clockless Chancellor, if titles still comfort anyone."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: You were dead.
lines.ja: 死んだはずじゃ……。
lines.tts_text: <breath> 死んだはずじゃ……。
lines.direction: Hushed, disbelieving alto; staring at her uncle on the altar steps.
lines.context: Scene 'The Hour That Remained'. Answering Fadyme: "Uncle."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: You made her curse.
lines.ja: 貴様が……彼女の呪いを作ったのか。
lines.tts_text: <breath> 貴様が……彼女の呪いを作ったのか。
lines.direction: Trembling with cold, lethal fury in a low baritone; facing the Clockless Chancellor.
lines.context: Scene 'The Hour That Remained'. Answering Cael: "The court recorded my death. It did not record where my missing hour went."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: And if I refuse?
lines.ja: ……断ると言ったら、どうする？
lines.tts_text: ……断ると言ったら、どうする？
lines.direction: Guarded, defiant, iron-steady baritone standing between Fadyme and her uncle.
lines.context: Scene 'The Hour That Remained'. Answering Cael: "Come to the Clockless Court, Mahmut. I can return the hours the curse has taken. The price is one hour that belongs to you."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Mahmut, do not answer him tonight.
lines.ja: マフムト。今夜は、答えないで。
lines.tts_text: マフムト。今夜は、答えないで。
lines.direction: Poised, luminous gothic alto; unhurried cadence with quiet dignity and natural breath.
lines.context: Scene 'The Hour That Remained'. Answering Cael: "Then she keeps fading, and you keep learning what 'too late' means."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: The handless watch ticked once. Somewhere below the altar, a bell answered.
lines.ja: 針のない懐中時計が、一度だけ時を刻んだ。祭壇の遥か下で、ひとつの鐘がそれに応えた。
lines.tts_text: <breath> 針のない懐中時計が、一度だけ時を刻んだ。祭壇の遥か下で、ひとつの鐘がそれに応えた。
lines.direction: Ominous, haunting final chronicle narration; low, lingering bass resonance as the handless watch ticks and a deep bell answers from the abyss.
lines.context: Scene 'The Hour That Remained'. Answering Fadyme: "Mahmut, do not answer him tonight."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: All this time, you were carrying something alone.
lines.ja: ……ずっと、お前はひとりでそれを背負っていたのか。
lines.tts_text: <breath> ……ずっと、お前はひとりでそれを背負っていたのか。
lines.direction: Shaken, hushed, heartbroken baritone; the truth of her curse finally crashing over him.
lines.context: Scene 'The Words He Did Not Know'. First line of the scene.

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: I thought if I smiled, the curse would have to wait its turn.
lines.ja: 笑っていれば……呪いのほうが、順番を待ってくれると思ったの。
lines.tts_text: <chuckle> 笑っていれば……呪いのほうが、順番を待ってくれると思ったの。
lines.direction: Climax emotional confession under the eclipse (weak_laugh): deeply vulnerable, raw, and heartfelt alto speaking to Mahmut with trembling honesty and tender devotion.
lines.context: Scene 'The Words He Did Not Know'. Answering Mahmut: "All this time, you were carrying something alone."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: You should have told me.
lines.ja: ……言ってくれるべきだった。俺にだけでも。
lines.tts_text: <sigh> ……言ってくれるべきだった。俺にだけでも。
lines.direction: Hurt, vulnerable, aching baritone; not angry at her, but grieving that she suffered alone.
lines.context: Scene 'The Words He Did Not Know'. Answering Fadyme: "I thought if I smiled, the curse would have to wait its turn."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: I know. I wanted to be more than the person you were trying to save.
lines.ja: わかってる。……あなたが救おうとしているだけの人で、いたくなかったの。
lines.tts_text: <breath> わかってる。……あなたが救おうとしているだけの人で、いたくなかったの。
lines.direction: Climax emotional confession under the eclipse (honest): deeply vulnerable, raw, and heartfelt alto speaking to Mahmut with trembling honesty and tender devotion.
lines.context: Scene 'The Words He Did Not Know'. Answering Mahmut: "You should have told me."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: You are. You are the person who made every road feel like it led somewhere.
lines.ja: 違う。……お前は、どんな道も『どこかへ続いている』と思わせてくれた人だ。
lines.tts_text: <breath> 違う。……お前は、どんな道も『どこかへ続いている』と思わせてくれた人だ。
lines.direction: Deeply tender, emotional, heartfelt baritone; telling her what she truly means to him.
lines.context: Scene 'The Words He Did Not Know'. Answering Fadyme: "I know. I wanted to be more than the person you were trying to save."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Then let me ask for one selfish thing. Stay until I fall asleep.
lines.ja: なら、ひとつだけ、わがままを言わせて。私が眠るまで、そばにいて。
lines.tts_text: <breath> なら、ひとつだけ、わがままを言わせて。私が眠るまで、そばにいて。
lines.direction: Climax emotional confession under the eclipse (fragile): deeply vulnerable, raw, and heartfelt alto speaking to Mahmut with trembling honesty and tender devotion.
lines.context: Scene 'The Words He Did Not Know'. Answering Mahmut: "You are. You are the person who made every road feel like it led somewhere."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: I will stay when you wake, too.
lines.ja: 目が覚めたときも、俺は傍にいる。
lines.tts_text: <breath> 目が覚めたときも、俺は傍にいる。
lines.direction: Resolved, steady, loving baritone holding her hand.
lines.context: Scene 'The Words He Did Not Know'. Answering Fadyme: "Then let me ask for one selfish thing. Stay until I fall asleep."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: You still do not understand. I am dying, Mahmut. The curse is taking my hours one by one.
lines.ja: まだ分かってないのね。私は死ぬの、マフムト。呪いが、私の時間をひとつずつ奪っていくの。
lines.tts_text: <breath> まだ分かってないのね。私は死ぬの、マフムト。呪いが、私の時間をひとつずつ奪っていくの。
lines.direction: Climax emotional confession under the eclipse (tearful): deeply vulnerable, raw, and heartfelt alto speaking to Mahmut with trembling honesty and tender devotion.
lines.context: Scene 'The Words He Did Not Know'. Answering Mahmut: "I will stay when you wake, too."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Then I will find the hand that wrote this curse. I will not let it write the last line.
lines.ja: なら、この呪いを書いた手を見つけ出す。最後の一行など、決して書かせはしない！
