lines.tts_text: <breath> なら、この呪いを書いた手を見つけ出す。最後の一行など、決して書かせはしない！
lines.direction: Grief surging into fierce, unbreakable resolve; a knight swearing war against the author of her death.
lines.context: Scene 'The Words He Did Not Know'. Answering Fadyme: "You still do not understand. I am dying, Mahmut. The curse is taking my hours one by one."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: I was afraid you would look at me and see a final hour.
lines.ja: あなたが私を見て、残りわずかな時間を見てしまうのが……怖かったの。
lines.tts_text: <breath> あなたが私を見て、残りわずかな時間を見てしまうのが……怖かったの。
lines.direction: Climax emotional confession under the eclipse (vulnerable): deeply vulnerable, raw, and heartfelt alto speaking to Mahmut with trembling honesty and tender devotion.
lines.context: Scene 'The Words He Did Not Know'. Answering Mahmut: "Then I will find the hand that wrote this curse. I will not let it write the last line."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: I see you. I should have seen you sooner.
lines.ja: 俺が見ているのは、お前だ。……もっと早く、気づいてやるべきだった。
lines.tts_text: <sigh> 俺が見ているのは、お前だ。……もっと早く、気づいてやるべきだった。
lines.direction: Remorseful, tender baritone; pulling her close with quiet sorrow and devotion.
lines.context: Scene 'The Words He Did Not Know'. Answering Fadyme: "I was afraid you would look at me and see a final hour."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: You did not know. That is why I could keep pretending.
lines.ja: あなたは知らなかった。だから私は、ふりを続けられたの。
lines.tts_text: <breath> あなたは知らなかった。だから私は、ふりを続けられたの。
lines.direction: Climax emotional confession under the eclipse (soft): deeply vulnerable, raw, and heartfelt alto speaking to Mahmut with trembling honesty and tender devotion.
lines.context: Scene 'The Words He Did Not Know'. Answering Mahmut: "I see you. I should have seen you sooner."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Then I have one more thing to confess. I knew Yseldra. I saw her call you to the altar that night, and I told you I did not know her.
lines.ja: なら、俺にもひとつ告白することがある。……俺はイゼルドラを知っていた。あの夜、あいつがお前を祭壇へ呼ぶのを見ていながら、知らぬと嘘をついた。
lines.tts_text: <breath> なら、俺にもひとつ告白することがある。<sigh> ……俺はイゼルドラを知っていた。あの夜、あいつがお前を祭壇へ呼ぶのを見ていながら、知らぬと嘘をついた。
lines.direction: Ashamed, completely honest baritone laying down his last secret before her.
lines.context: Scene 'The Words He Did Not Know'. Answering Fadyme: "You did not know. That is why I could keep pretending."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: I know. I heard it in the cathedral. We were both pretending, Mahmut. Let us stop together.
lines.ja: 知ってる。大聖堂で、聞こえていたの。私たち、二人ともふりをしていたのね、マフムト。……一緒に、やめましょう。
lines.tts_text: <breath> 知ってる。大聖堂で、聞こえていたの。私たち、二人ともふりをしていたのね、マフムト。……一緒に、やめましょう。
lines.direction: Climax emotional confession under the eclipse (tearful): deeply vulnerable, raw, and heartfelt alto speaking to Mahmut with trembling honesty and tender devotion.
lines.context: Scene 'The Words He Did Not Know'. Answering Mahmut: "Then I have one more thing to confess. I knew Yseldra. I saw her call you to the altar that night, and I told you I did not know her."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: For one breath, the eclipse above them thinned. Fadyme's fingers found Mahmut's, and the darkness beneath her skin did not retreat.
lines.ja: ひと息の間だけ、頭上の蝕が薄れた。ファディメの指がマフムトの指を見つけ、彼女の肌の下にある闇は、それでも退かなかった。
lines.tts_text: <breath> ひと息の間だけ、頭上の蝕が薄れた。ファディメの指がマフムトの指を見つけ、<sigh> 彼女の肌の下にある闇は、それでも退かなかった。
lines.direction: Deeply moving, tragic yet tender chronicle narration; intimate reverence as their fingers intertwine beneath the thinning eclipse.
lines.context: Scene 'The Words He Did Not Know'. Answering Fadyme: "I know. I heard it in the cathedral. We were both pretending, Mahmut. Let us stop together."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: The last one ran when the bell stopped.
lines.ja: 鐘が止んだ途端、最後の一頭は逃げていったな。
lines.tts_text: <exhales> 鐘が止んだ途端、最後の一頭は逃げていったな。
lines.direction: Watchful, post-battle low baritone; lowering his weapon slightly while scanning the mist.
lines.context: Scene 'The Road That Whispers'. First line of the scene.

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: It did not stop. It only learned to whisper.
lines.ja: 止まってなんかいない。ささやき方を覚えただけよ。
lines.tts_text: <sigh> 止まってなんかいない。ささやき方を覚えただけよ。
lines.direction: Bittersweet, softly smiling alto tinged with quiet ache; tender and wistful.
lines.context: Scene 'The Road That Whispers'. Answering Mahmut: "The last one ran when the bell stopped."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: One step. Then another. The road does not need to know how many it costs.
lines.ja: 一歩。それから、もう一歩。何歩ぶんの代償か、道に知らせる必要はない。
lines.tts_text: 一歩。それから、もう一歩。何歩ぶんの代償か、道に知らせる必要はない。
lines.direction: Resolute, unwavering inner alto making a quiet vow.
lines.context: Scene 'The Road That Whispers'. Answering Fadyme: "It did not stop. It only learned to whisper."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Three wolves. Stay behind my shield.
lines.ja: 狼が三頭だ。俺の盾の後ろにいろ。
lines.tts_text: 狼が三頭だ。俺の盾の後ろにいろ。
lines.direction: Alert, commanding combat baritone; calm tactical authority as ash wolves emerge.
lines.context: Scene 'The Road That Whispers'. First line of the scene.

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: You say that as if I have ever listened.
lines.ja: 私が一度でも言うことを聞いたみたいな言い方ね。
lines.tts_text: <chuckle> 私が一度でも言うことを聞いたみたいな言い方ね。
lines.direction: Poised, witty alto with dry aristocratic amusement and a playful lilt.
lines.context: Scene 'The Road That Whispers'. Answering Mahmut: "Three wolves. Stay behind my shield."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: The bell has no clapper. Why can I still hear it?
lines.ja: あの鐘には、ぜつがない。なのに、どうしてまだ聞こえるの？
lines.tts_text: <breath> あの鐘には、ぜつがない。なのに、どうしてまだ聞こえるの？
lines.direction: Internal monologue (close-mic inner thought): Guarded, uneasy alto sensing the bell's resonance in the mist. Delivered in an intimate, hushed self-reflective cadence.
lines.context: Scene 'The Road That Whispers'. Answering Fadyme: "You say that as if I have ever listened."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: That is farther than the next shrine.
lines.ja: 次の祠よりも、ずいぶん遠い場所だな。
lines.tts_text: <exhales> 次の祠よりも、ずいぶん遠い場所だな。
lines.direction: Wry, dryly observant baritone; understated veteran humor.
lines.context: Scene 'No Bell in the Trees'. Answering Brin: "The woodcutters are safe. I will walk with you until the next bell is silent."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: Brin joins permanently as a story recruit. Nixie and Kera remain as temporary story loans for the next stretch. The shrine keeper gives the party a First Oath Invitation.
lines.ja: ブリンが正式に一行へと加わった。ニクシーとケラは次の道のりまで同行し、祠の守り手は一行に『最初の誓いの招待状』を託した。
lines.tts_text: ブリンが正式に一行へと加わった。ニクシーとケラは次の道のりまで同行し、祠の守り手は一行に『最初の誓いの招待状』を託した。
lines.direction: Serene, dignified chronicle narrator recording a fellowship milestone along the ash road.
lines.context: Scene 'No Bell in the Trees'. Answering Kera: "And I am going to retrieve my bottles before they become somebody else's research."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: You do not have to hold it alone.
lines.ja: ひとりで支えなくていい。俺たちも手を貸す。
lines.tts_text: ひとりで支えなくていい。俺たちも手を貸す。
lines.direction: Steady, reassuring baritone; stepping in to shoulder the collapsing shrine beam beside Brin.
lines.context: Scene 'No Bell in the Trees'. Answering Brin: "If I move, the roof comes down. If I stay, they reach the children."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Three hands for the beam and three swords for the dead. We can manage both.
lines.ja: はりを支える手が三つ、死者に向ける剣がみふり。両方こなせるわ。
lines.tts_text: はりを支える手が三つ、死者に向ける剣がみふり。両方こなせるわ。
lines.direction: Clear, warm, encouraging alto lifting a companion's spirits.
lines.context: Scene 'No Bell in the Trees'. Answering Mahmut: "You do not have to hold it alone."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: You are coming with us?
lines.ja: 一緒に来てくれるの？
lines.tts_text: 一緒に来てくれるの？
lines.direction: Gentle, inquisitive alto asking a thoughtful question.
lines.context: Scene 'A Cart of Empty Bottles'. Answering Kera: "Take this route map. The Red Vial Guild owes me a favor, and now it owes you one too."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: We can help you gather them after the dead are gone.
lines.ja: 死者どもを片づけたあとで、一緒に集めるのを手伝おう。
lines.tts_text: 死者どもを片づけたあとで、一緒に集めるのを手伝おう。
lines.direction: Calm, practical, grounded baritone; offering help once the immediate danger is cleared.
lines.context: Scene 'A Cart of Empty Bottles'. Answering Kera: "Those bottles were sorted by volatility. You have turned them into a choir."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: You do not have to stay with us.
lines.ja: 無理に、私たちと来なくてもいいのよ。
lines.tts_text: 無理に、私たちと来なくてもいいのよ。
lines.direction: Soft, soothing, compassionate alto; unhurried and kind.
lines.context: Scene 'The Map’s Little Lie'. Answering Nixie: "I was going to Oakhaven anyway. I will take the rear watch."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: Nixie joins permanently. The company now has five owned heroes: Mahmut, Fadyme, Brin, Nixie and the companion chosen by invitation.
lines.ja: ニクシーが正式に仲間となった。マフムト、ファディメ、ブリン、ニクシー、そして誓いに応えた旅人——一行は五人の絆となった。
lines.tts_text: ニクシーが正式に仲間となった。マフムト、ファディメ、ブリン、ニクシー、そして誓いに応えた旅人——一行は五人の絆となった。
lines.direction: Warm, resonant chronicle narrator marking the formation of the five-hero company.
lines.context: Scene 'The Map’s Little Lie'. Answering Nixie: "I know. That is why I can choose to."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: And you learned that by climbing a tree?
lines.ja: 木に登って、それを知ったというのか？
lines.tts_text: 木に登って、それを知ったというのか？
lines.direction: Dryly skeptical, amused low baritone; raising an eyebrow at Nixie up in the branches.
lines.context: Scene 'The Map’s Little Lie'. Answering Nixie: "Do not follow the map. The map is lying. The wolves learned the road from it."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: They will forget the sound by morning.
lines.ja: 朝になれば、あの音も忘れるわ。
lines.tts_text: 朝になれば、あの音も忘れるわ。
lines.direction: Gentle, reassuring alto hiding her own illness behind a brave, soothing smile.
lines.context: Scene 'The Ash-Maw'. Answering Brin: "The bell stopped. The trees are still whispering."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Your hand is freezing.
lines.ja: ……お前の手、氷のように冷たいぞ。
lines.tts_text: <breath> ……お前の手、氷のように冷たいぞ。
lines.direction: Deep, hushed concern; holding her freezing hand in the rain after the boss fight.
lines.context: Scene 'The Ash-Maw'. Answering Fadyme: "They will forget the sound by morning."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Rain does that. I am perfectly fine.
lines.ja: 雨のせいよ。私は、まったく平気。
lines.tts_text: 雨のせいよ。私は、まったく平気。
lines.direction: Poised young woman putting on a brave, gentle smile ('I am perfectly fine') while subtly hiding exhaustion and chill beneath her warm, composed alto.
lines.context: Scene 'The Ash-Maw'. Answering Mahmut: "Your hand is freezing."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: My fingertips have gone pale. I will tell him after the next town.
lines.ja: 指先が白くなってきた。次の町を過ぎたら、彼に話そう。
lines.tts_text: <sigh> 指先が白くなってきた。次の町を過ぎたら、彼に話そう。
lines.direction: Internal monologue (close-mic inner thought): Hushed, melancholic alto carrying quiet sorrow without melodrama. Delivered in an intimate, hushed self-reflective cadence.
lines.context: Scene 'The Ash-Maw'. Answering Fadyme: "Rain does that. I am perfectly fine."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Front line, hold. Rear line, wait for the jaw to open.
lines.ja: 前衛は踏みとどまれ！ 後衛は、顎が開く瞬間を待て！
lines.tts_text: 前衛は踏みとどまれ！ 後衛は、顎が開く瞬間を待て！
lines.direction: Urgent, commanding battlefield baritone; leading the formation against the cursed beast.
lines.context: Scene 'The Ash-Maw'. Answering Nixie: "That is not a wolf. That is what the bell left wearing one."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: When it opens, strike the clapper. We only get one clean chance.
lines.ja: あごが開いたら、鐘のぜつを狙って。好機は一度きりよ。
lines.tts_text: あごが開いたら、鐘のぜつを狙って。好機は一度きりよ。
lines.direction: Sharp, tactical, focused combat alto calling out the enemy's weakness.
lines.context: Scene 'The Ash-Maw'. Answering Mahmut: "Front line, hold. Rear line, wait for the jaw to open."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: You should not have to choose between people and the truth.
lines.ja: 人と真実のどちらかを、あなたが選ばなければならないなんて……そんなはず、ありません。
lines.tts_text: <breath> 人と真実のどちらかを、あなたが選ばなければならないなんて……そんなはず、ありません。
lines.direction: Soft, gentle alto near a whisper.
lines.context: Scene 'The Choir Without Breath'. Answering Aveline: "I will stay until every candle in the refuge is lit. Then I will follow the records."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Can you get the pilgrims through?
lines.ja: 巡礼者たちを、無事に通せるか？
lines.tts_text: 巡礼者たちを、無事に通せるか？
lines.direction: Focused, concerned baritone prioritizing civilian safety.
lines.context: Scene 'The Choir Without Breath'. Answering Aveline: "Their ward is shared. Strike the bond, not the armor."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: You know who belongs there.
lines.ja: そこに誰の名があるべきか、お前には分かっているんだな。
lines.tts_text: <breath> そこに誰の名があるべきか、お前には分かっているんだな。
lines.direction: Measured, perceptive low baritone; quietly realizing Fadyme recognizes the erased name.
lines.context: Scene 'The Guest Roll'. Answering Mirel: "There is a gap exactly where the heir’s name should be."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: I know who they wanted the world to forget.
lines.ja: 世界に忘れさせたかった誰かなら、知っているわ。
lines.tts_text: <sigh> 世界に忘れさせたかった誰かなら、知っているわ。
lines.direction: Hushed, melancholic alto carrying quiet sorrow without melodrama.
lines.context: Scene 'The Guest Roll'. Answering Mahmut: "You know who belongs there."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: And the world is already doing it.
lines.ja: そして世界は、もう忘れ始めている。
lines.tts_text: <breath> そして世界は、もう忘れ始めている。
lines.direction: Internal monologue (close-mic inner thought): Soft, fearful, unguarded alto; quiet dread as the curse nears her heart. Delivered in an intimate, hushed self-reflective cadence.
lines.context: Scene 'The Guest Roll'. Answering Fadyme: "I know who they wanted the world to forget."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Perhaps the ink had spoiled.
lines.ja: インクが傷んでいただけかもしれません。
lines.tts_text: インクが傷んでいただけかもしれません。
lines.direction: Cool, tightly controlled aristocratic alto.
lines.context: Scene 'The Guest Roll'. Answering Mirel: "This register lists every royal visitor since the old king was crowned. One name was removed with a knife."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: The person who wrote it may have thought it was mercy.
lines.ja: それを書いた人は、慈悲のつもりだったのかもしれない。
lines.tts_text: それを書いた人は、慈悲のつもりだったのかもしれない。
lines.direction: Measured, guarded alto keeping her composure tight.
lines.context: Scene 'A Page Beneath the Font'. First line of the scene.

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Mercy does not need a missing page.
lines.ja: 慈悲なら、ページを破り取る必要などないはずだ。
lines.tts_text: 慈悲なら、ページを破り取る必要などないはずだ。
lines.direction: Grim, skeptical baritone; seeing through the excuse of a torn ledger page.
lines.context: Scene 'A Page Beneath the Font'. Answering Fadyme: "The person who wrote it may have thought it was mercy."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: No. But people do.
lines.ja: そうね。でも、人には必要なのよ。
lines.tts_text: そうね。でも、人には必要なのよ。
lines.direction: Quiet, intimate, unhurried alto.
lines.context: Scene 'A Page Beneath the Font'. Answering Mahmut: "Mercy does not need a missing page."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Who wrote the promise?
lines.ja: その誓約を書いたのは、誰だ？
lines.tts_text: その誓約を書いたのは、誰だ？
lines.direction: Direct, firm, probing baritone demanding the truth.
lines.context: Scene 'A Page Beneath the Font'. Answering Mirel: "The sentence continues on a page someone carried away."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: She escaped.
lines.ja: ……逃げられたか。
lines.tts_text: <exhales> ……逃げられたか。
lines.direction: Frustrated, low baritone exhale as the Bell-Widow vanishes into the mist.
lines.context: Scene 'The Bell-Widow’s Verdict'. First line of the scene.

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: She knows I am dying. That does not mean I can let Mahmut know.
lines.ja: あの人は、私が死にかけていると知っている。だからといって、マフムトに知られていいわけじゃない。
lines.tts_text: <breath> あの人は、私が死にかけていると知っている。だからといって、マフムトに知られていいわけじゃない。
lines.direction: Internal monologue (close-mic inner thought): Soft, fearful, unguarded alto; quiet dread as the curse nears her heart. Delivered in an intimate, hushed self-reflective cadence.
lines.context: Scene 'The Bell-Widow’s Verdict'. Answering Nixie: "Oakhaven is marked on the map. I will warn them before the soldiers arrive."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: He lied to me, gently. So we are both keeping something.
lines.ja: 彼は私に嘘をついた。優しく。……私たち、どちらも何かを隠しているのね。
lines.tts_text: <breath> 彼は私に嘘をついた。優しく。……私たち、どちらも何かを隠しているのね。
lines.direction: Quietly wounded, sensitive inner alto.
lines.context: Scene 'The Bell-Widow’s Verdict'. Answering Fadyme (thought): "She knows I am dying. That does not mean I can let Mahmut know."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Then tell us.
lines.ja: なら、今すぐここで話せ！
lines.tts_text: なら、今すぐここで話せ！
lines.direction: Angry, confrontational baritone confronting the Bell-Widow inside the cathedral.
lines.context: Scene 'The Bell-Widow’s Verdict'. Answering Yseldra: "You found the record. You still do not know what it asks of her."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: You came to take me away.
lines.ja: 私を、連れて行きに来たのね。
lines.tts_text: 私を、連れて行きに来たのね。
lines.direction: Quiet, intimate, unhurried alto.
lines.context: Scene 'The Bell-Widow’s Verdict'. Answering Yseldra: "The altar does not cure. It keeps a wound open until the kingdom can be put back inside it."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Mahmut?
lines.ja: マフムト……？
lines.tts_text: <breath> マフムト……？
lines.direction: Breathless, stunned alto whisper; recognizing someone who should have been dead.
lines.context: Scene 'The Bell-Widow’s Verdict'. Answering Yseldra: "And you, Sir Mahmut. You told her you did not know me."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Not now.
lines.ja: ……今はいい。あとで話す。
lines.tts_text: <breath> ……今はいい。あとで話す。
lines.direction: Tight, strained baritone; caught in his earlier lie as battle begins.
lines.context: Scene 'The Bell-Widow’s Verdict'. Answering Fadyme: "Mahmut?"

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: You held the gate long enough for everyone to run.
lines.ja: 住民が全員逃げるまで、ひとりで門を守り抜いたんだな。見事だった。
lines.tts_text: 住民が全員逃げるまで、ひとりで門を守り抜いたんだな。見事だった。
lines.direction: Respectful, warm veteran baritone honoring a fellow defender's stand.
lines.context: Scene 'A Smith’s Last Bell'. First line of the scene.

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Then walk with us. A shield belongs where people need it.
lines.ja: なら、私たちと行きましょう。盾は、人が必要とする場所にあるべきよ。
lines.tts_text: なら、私たちと行きましょう。盾は、人が必要とする場所にあるべきよ。
lines.direction: Tender, heartfelt alto radiating quiet gratitude and companionship.
lines.context: Scene 'A Smith’s Last Bell'. Answering Jori: "I made the shield because I was tired of doors being the only thing between us and danger."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: There is red on my gauntlet.
lines.ja: ……籠手に、赤い血がついている。俺の血じゃない。
lines.tts_text: <breath> ……籠手に、赤い血がついている。俺の血じゃない。
lines.direction: Sudden, quiet alarm and concern; staring at the bloodstain on his gauntlet.
lines.context: Scene 'The Well Runs Red'. First line of the scene.

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Then the enemy finally managed to hit you.
lines.ja: なら、やっと敵があなたにひとたち浴びせたのね。
lines.tts_text: なら、やっと敵があなたにひとたち浴びせたのね。
lines.direction: Understated, dryly observant alto; crisp and unhurried.
lines.context: Scene 'The Well Runs Red'. Answering Mahmut: "There is red on my gauntlet."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: I wiped my own blood on his glove. He must not count the drops.
lines.ja: 自分の血を、彼のこてで拭ってしまった。しずくの数を、数えさせてはいけない。
lines.tts_text: <sigh> 自分の血を、彼のこてで拭ってしまった。しずくの数を、数えさせてはいけない。
lines.direction: Internal monologue (close-mic inner thought): Hushed, melancholic alto carrying quiet sorrow without melodrama. Delivered in an intimate, hushed self-reflective cadence.
lines.context: Scene 'The Well Runs Red'. Answering Fadyme: "Then the enemy finally managed to hit you."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Fadyme, take the left side. I have the well.
lines.ja: ファディメ、左翼を頼む！ 井戸の周りは俺が抑える！
lines.tts_text: ファディメ、左翼を頼む！ 井戸の周りは俺が抑える！
lines.direction: Crisp, commanding battle baritone amidst the burning village.
lines.context: Scene 'The Well Runs Red'. First line of the scene.

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: I can reach both.
lines.ja: 両方、届くわ。
lines.tts_text: <exhales> 両方、届くわ。
lines.direction: Strained, breathless alto; masking physical pain behind a tight, controlled cadence.
lines.context: Scene 'The Well Runs Red'. Answering Mahmut: "Fadyme, take the left side. I have the well."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: It is the mercenary’s blood. Keep the bucket moving.
lines.ja: 傭兵の血よ。バケツを止めないで。
lines.tts_text: 傭兵の血よ。バケツを止めないで。
lines.direction: Poised, graceful alto deflecting concern with dry, effortless elegance.
lines.context: Scene 'The Well Runs Red'. Answering Jori: "Your hand is bleeding."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Then the road has room for one more.
lines.ja: ああ。この道には、もうひとり分の余地くらいあるさ。
lines.tts_text: <chuckle> ああ。この道には、もうひとり分の余地くらいあるさ。
lines.direction: Warm, welcoming low baritone; inviting Jori into the company.
lines.context: Scene 'The Inn of Borrowed Names'. Answering Jori: "I will go with Mahmut and Fadyme. The village has its gate back."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: Jori joins permanently as a story recruit.
lines.ja: ジョリが正式に一行へと加わった。
lines.tts_text: ジョリが正式に一行へと加わった。
lines.direction: Calm, steady chronicle narrator noting a new companion joining the road.
lines.context: Scene 'The Inn of Borrowed Names'. Answering Mahmut: "Then the road has room for one more."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Not everything precious can be written down.
lines.ja: 大切なものが、全部書き残せるとは限らないわ。
lines.tts_text: 大切なものが、全部書き残せるとは限らないわ。
lines.direction: Soft, soothing, compassionate alto; unhurried and kind.
lines.context: Scene 'The Inn of Borrowed Names'. Answering Jori: "People are smiling again. I thought the bell took that too."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Do those initials mean anything to you?
lines.ja: その頭文字に、何か心当たりがあるのか？
lines.tts_text: <breath> その頭文字に、何か心当たりがあるのか？
lines.direction: Attentive, questioning baritone watching Fadyme's reaction to the initials 'C.V.'
lines.context: Scene 'The Mercenary Captain'. Answering Kera: "Seven notches. Same wax as the seal on your shield. There are letters beneath it: C.V."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: C.V. I saw those letters on my father’s last page.
lines.ja: シー、ヴィー……お父様の最後のページで、あの文字を見た。
lines.tts_text: <breath> シー、ヴィー……お父様の最後のページで、あの文字を見た。
lines.direction: Internal monologue (close-mic inner thought): Shaken, hushed alto after a chilling revelation. Delivered in an intimate, hushed self-reflective cadence.
lines.context: Scene 'The Mercenary Captain'. Answering Kera: "Not yet. The Red Vial ledger may know."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: We should find a healer before we open the order.
lines.ja: 命令書を開くのは、治療師を見つけてからにしましょう。
lines.tts_text: 命令書を開くのは、治療師を見つけてからにしましょう。
lines.direction: Poised, graceful alto deflecting concern with dry, effortless elegance.
lines.context: Scene 'The Mercenary Captain'. Answering Fadyme (thought): "C.V. I saw those letters on my father’s last page."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Then I will carry it, sealed, until we do.
lines.ja: 分かった。治療師が見つかるまで、封を切らずに俺が預かろう。
lines.tts_text: 分かった。治療師が見つかるまで、封を切らずに俺が預かろう。
lines.direction: Steady, reassuring baritone respecting Fadyme's wish to find a healer first.
lines.context: Scene 'The Mercenary Captain'. Answering Fadyme: "We should find a healer before we open the order."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Your order is written by cowards.
lines.ja: 貴様らの命令書とやらは、臆病者が書いたものだ。
lines.tts_text: 貴様らの命令書とやらは、臆病者が書いたものだ。
lines.direction: Cold, angry, contemptuous knight baritone condemning the mercenary captain's orders.
lines.context: Scene 'The Mercenary Captain'. Answering Captain Rusk: "The order says the heir comes quietly. It says nothing about the village."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: You have given the city a place to breathe.
lines.ja: この街に、息のできる場所をくださったんですね。
lines.tts_text: この街に、息のできる場所をくださったんですね。
lines.direction: Tender, heartfelt alto radiating quiet gratitude and companionship.
lines.context: Scene 'The Red Vial Ward'. Answering Iona: "We will reopen this ward after the Guild is settled."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: And if I stop answering?
lines.ja: では……私が応えるのをやめたら？
lines.tts_text: では……私が応えるのをやめたら？
lines.direction: Cool, tightly controlled aristocratic alto.
lines.context: Scene 'The Measure of a Life'. Answering Undercity Alchemist: "Not a month now. Weeks, perhaps less, if the bell keeps calling."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: That is enough for tonight.
lines.ja: ……今夜は、もう十分だ。休め。
lines.tts_text: <exhales> ……今夜は、もう十分だ。休め。
lines.direction: Tired, gentle baritone letting the day's weight settle.
lines.context: Scene 'The Elixir Lie'. Answering Kera: "I will try. I will not promise a cure."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: He accepted a hope because I asked him to. I will have to live with that.
lines.ja: 私が頼んだから、彼は希望を受け取った。私はそれを抱えて生きていくしかない。
lines.tts_text: <sigh> 私が頼んだから、彼は希望を受け取った。私はそれを抱えて生きていくしかない。
lines.direction: Hushed, remorseful inner alto weighed down by the hope she asked him to carry.
lines.context: Scene 'The Elixir Lie'. Answering Mahmut: "That is enough for tonight."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: What did the alchemist say?
lines.ja: ……錬金術師は、何と言っていた？
lines.tts_text: <breath> ……錬金術師は、何と言っていた？
lines.direction: Careful, anxiously hopeful baritone; afraid of the answer yet desperate for good news.
lines.context: Scene 'The Elixir Lie'. First line of the scene.

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: That the elixir might work.
lines.ja: 霊薬が効くかもしれない、って。
lines.tts_text: 霊薬が効くかもしれない、って。
lines.direction: Steady, grounded, unwavering alto.
lines.context: Scene 'The Elixir Lie'. Answering Mahmut: "What did the alchemist say?"

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Then complete it. You are good at turning bad mixtures into useful ones.
lines.ja: なら、完成させて。ひどい調合を役に立つものに変えるのは、あなたの得意でしょう？
lines.tts_text: <breath> なら、完成させて。ひどい調合を役に立つものに変えるのは、あなたの得意でしょう？
lines.direction: Soft, gentle alto near a whisper.
lines.context: Scene 'The Elixir Lie'. Answering Kera: "The label is wrong. The recipe is incomplete."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: We will come back for you.
lines.ja: 必ず戻ってくる。約束する。
lines.tts_text: 必ず戻ってくる。約束する。
lines.direction: Earnest, unwavering baritone making a knight's promise.
lines.context: Scene 'The Red Vial Matron'. Answering Iona: "I will hang the lantern first. People should see the door before they need it."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Weeks. Perhaps less. The words do not become kinder when repeated.
lines.ja: 数週間。もっと短いかもしれない。繰り返しても、優しい言葉にはならない。
lines.tts_text: <sigh> 数週間。もっと短いかもしれない。繰り返しても、優しい言葉にはならない。
lines.direction: Internal monologue (close-mic inner thought): Hushed, melancholic alto carrying quiet sorrow without melodrama. Delivered in an intimate, hushed self-reflective cadence.
lines.context: Scene 'The Red Vial Matron'. Answering Jori: "Oakhaven has no smith while I am down here. I am going home to hold the gate. Send word when something needs a door."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Break the flasks. Do not let her finish the sentence.
lines.ja: フラスコを割って。あの人に、最後まで言わせないで。
lines.tts_text: フラスコを割って。あの人に、最後まで言わせないで。
lines.direction: Sharp, tactical, focused combat alto calling out the enemy's weakness.
lines.context: Scene 'The Red Vial Matron'. Answering Kera: "I knew the Guild was using the wrong formula. I did not know it was using her."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: You sing as if the bridge is still standing.
lines.ja: まるで、橋がまだ架かっているみたいに歌うんですね。
lines.tts_text: まるで、橋がまだ架かっているみたいに歌うんですね。
lines.direction: Gentle, inquisitive alto asking a thoughtful question.
lines.context: Scene 'A Banner in the Fog'. Answering Marek: "The refugees are across. I will carry your warning to the next watch post."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: The road remembers a version of me that no longer exists.
lines.ja: この街道が覚えているのは……もうどこにもいない、昔の俺だ。
lines.tts_text: <sigh> この街道が覚えているのは……もうどこにもいない、昔の俺だ。
lines.direction: Guarded, somber baritone carrying old military scars at the Shattered Bridge.
lines.context: Scene 'A Banner in the Fog'. Answering Marek: "That socket used to carry a crown. The road has not forgotten."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: You always put yourself between people and the fall.
lines.ja: あなたはいつも、人と崩れ落ちるものの間に立つんですね。
lines.tts_text: <breath> あなたはいつも、人と崩れ落ちるものの間に立つんですね。
lines.direction: Soft, gentle alto near a whisper.
lines.context: Scene 'The Gatekeeper’s Measure'. Answering Nara: "The civilians are clear. I will stay with the gate until the last cart crosses."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: You hold the civilians. We take the winches.
lines.ja: 民間人を守っていてくれ。巻き上げ機は俺たちが奪う。
lines.tts_text: 民間人を守っていてくれ。巻き上げ機は俺たちが奪う。
lines.direction: Certain, tactical baritone coordinating the bridge defense.
lines.context: Scene 'The Gatekeeper’s Measure'. Answering Nara: "The gate can hold for one minute. The winches can be stopped in ten seconds. Choose the faster danger."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: My commander signed it.
lines.ja: ……俺の上官が、これに署名を？
lines.tts_text: <breath> ……俺の上官が、これに署名を？
lines.direction: Stunned, disbelieving low baritone; staring at his former commander's signature on the betrayal order.
lines.context: Scene 'A Knife Between Orders'. Answering Sable: "This order names Fadyme. The seal belongs to the old Crown Guard."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Then we ask him why.
lines.ja: なら、本人に理由を聞きましょう。
lines.tts_text: なら、本人に理由を聞きましょう。
lines.direction: Quiet, intimate, unhurried alto.
lines.context: Scene 'A Knife Between Orders'. Answering Mahmut: "My commander signed it."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Only tired. The wind is colder here.
lines.ja: ……少し疲れただけ。ここは、風が冷たいのね。
lines.tts_text: <breath> ……少し疲れただけ。ここは、風が冷たいのね。
lines.direction: Deliberately light, overly composed alto masking deep pain; the classic 'I am perfectly fine' smile hiding a tremor.
lines.context: Scene 'The White Strand'. First line of the scene.

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: You have been tired since the forest.
lines.ja: ……あの森を出てからずっと、お前は疲れている。
lines.tts_text: <breath> ……あの森を出てからずっと、お前は疲れている。
lines.direction: Quiet, serious, unyielding baritone; no longer accepting her polite deflections.
lines.context: Scene 'The White Strand'. Answering Fadyme: "Only tired. The wind is colder here."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Then I have been consistent.
lines.ja: なら、私はずっと一貫しているのね。
lines.tts_text: なら、私はずっと一貫しているのね。
lines.direction: Gentle, understated alto with a faint, warm smile.
lines.context: Scene 'The White Strand'. Answering Mahmut: "You have been tired since the forest."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Consistent is not the same as well.
lines.ja: 『一貫している』ことと、『無事である』ことは、同じじゃない。
lines.tts_text: 『一貫している』ことと、『無事である』ことは、同じじゃない。
lines.direction: Quiet, piercing honesty in a low baritone; gently stripping away her witty mask.
lines.context: Scene 'The White Strand'. Answering Fadyme: "Then I have been consistent."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: She does not answer. For the first time, he does not let the question go, and for the first time, she has nothing ready.
lines.ja: 彼女は答えない。初めて彼はその問いを手放さず、そして初めて、彼女には返す言葉が用意されていなかった。
lines.tts_text: <breath> 彼女は答えない。初めて彼はその問いを手放さず、そして初めて、彼女には返す言葉が用意されていなかった。
lines.direction: Hushed, tense, emotionally heavy chronicle narration; the quiet turning point where her mask begins to crack.
lines.context: Scene 'The White Strand'. Answering Mahmut: "Consistent is not the same as well."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: A white strand. One more thing the mirror will remember before he does.
lines.ja: 白いひと筋。彼より先に、鏡が覚えてしまうものが、またひとつ。
lines.tts_text: <sigh> 白いひと筋。彼より先に、鏡が覚えてしまうものが、またひとつ。
lines.direction: Internal monologue (close-mic inner thought): Hushed, melancholic alto carrying quiet sorrow without melodrama. Delivered in an intimate, hushed self-reflective cadence.
lines.context: Scene 'The White Strand'. Answering Narration: "She does not answer. For the first time, he does not let the question go, and for the first time, she has nothing ready."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: I was not going to run.
lines.ja: 逃げるつもりなんて、なかったわ。
lines.tts_text: <breath> 逃げるつもりなんて、なかったわ。
lines.direction: Slightly breathless, tired alto; pausing to catch her breath in the cold wind.
lines.context: Scene 'The White Strand'. Answering Odelia: "The stones are hollow under the third span. Do not run when the bell rings."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Your voice changed. Are you hurt?
lines.ja: ……声が変わったぞ。どこか痛むのか？
lines.tts_text: <breath> ……声が変わったぞ。どこか痛むのか？
lines.direction: Immediate, sharp concern; hearing the slightest tremor in Fadyme's voice.
lines.context: Scene 'The White Strand'. Answering Fadyme: "I was not going to run."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: You are coming with us.
lines.ja: あんたも、俺たちと一緒に来てもらう。
lines.tts_text: あんたも、俺たちと一緒に来てもらう。
lines.direction: Hard, uncompromising baritone taking his former commander into custody.
lines.context: Scene 'The Commander Who Remained'. Answering Oren: "The Ashen estate has the full schedule. Go before the bridge falls."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: The white strand is small. I can still hide something small.
lines.ja: 白いひと筋は小さい。小さなものなら、まだ隠せる。
lines.tts_text: <sigh> 白いひと筋は小さい。小さなものなら、まだ隠せる。
lines.direction: Internal monologue (close-mic inner thought): Hushed, melancholic alto carrying quiet sorrow without melodrama. Delivered in an intimate, hushed self-reflective cadence.
lines.context: Scene 'The Commander Who Remained'. Answering Rikka: "My kiln company is guarding the refugee road. They need someone loud. I am extremely loud!"

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: You knew enough to send men after her.
lines.ja: それでも、彼女を追わせるだけのことは知っていたはずだ。
lines.tts_text: それでも、彼女を追わせるだけのことは知っていたはずだ。
lines.direction: Low, controlled anger confronting Commander Oren on the bridge.
lines.context: Scene 'The Commander Who Remained'. Answering Oren: "I gave the order. I did not know the rite would hollow her out."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: You thought a promise was the same as a plan.
lines.ja: 約束を、計画と同じものだと思われたのですね。
lines.tts_text: 約束を、計画と同じものだと思われたのですね。
lines.direction: Cold, dignified, piercing aristocratic alto addressing an enemy.
lines.context: Scene 'The Commander Who Remained'. Answering Oren: "I thought the seal would save the kingdom without consuming its heir."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: That is often what courage looks like.
lines.ja: 勇気って、たいていそういう形をしているのよ。
lines.tts_text: 勇気って、たいていそういう形をしているのよ。
lines.direction: Tender, heartfelt alto radiating quiet gratitude and companionship.
lines.context: Scene 'The Servants’ Entrance'. Answering Sable: "They did shake. You still opened the door."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Take the rear passage. We will keep the sentinel busy.
lines.ja: 裏通路から行け。番兵は俺たちが引きつける。
lines.tts_text: 裏通路から行け。番兵は俺たちが引きつける。
lines.direction: Steady, low tactical baritone infiltrating the Vale Estate.
lines.context: Scene 'The Servants’ Entrance'. Answering Hana: "There are children under the stair. I can get them out."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: She was my mother.
lines.ja: ……私の、お母様よ。
lines.tts_text: <breath> ……私の、お母様よ。
lines.direction: Soft, gentle alto near a whisper.
lines.context: Scene 'Portraits Without Names'. First line of the scene.

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: You never told me she was here.
lines.ja: ……お母上の肖像画がここにあるとは、言わなかったな。
lines.tts_text: <breath> ……お母上の肖像画がここにあるとは、言わなかったな。
lines.direction: Gentle, hushed baritone standing beside Fadyme before her late mother's portrait.
lines.context: Scene 'Portraits Without Names'. Answering Fadyme: "She was my mother."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: I was not sure I remembered her correctly.
lines.ja: ちゃんと覚えているのか、自信がなかったの。
lines.tts_text: <sigh> ちゃんと覚えているのか、自信がなかったの。
lines.direction: Hushed, melancholic alto carrying quiet sorrow without melodrama.
lines.context: Scene 'Portraits Without Names'. Answering Mahmut: "You never told me she was here."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Then you know how easily it happens. That is not the same as choosing it.
lines.ja: なら、それがどれほど簡単に起きるか、あなたは知っている。それは、自分で選ぶこととは違います。
lines.tts_text: なら、それがどれほど簡単に起きるか、あなたは知っている。それは、自分で選ぶこととは違います。
lines.direction: Soft, soothing, compassionate alto; unhurried and kind.
lines.context: Scene 'Portraits Without Names'. Answering Mirel: "Wait. The order that cut these names was copied in my hand. I was a court scribe. I never asked whose names they were."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Can a room miss someone?
lines.ja: 部屋も、誰かを恋しく思うことがあるんでしょうか。
lines.tts_text: 部屋も、誰かを恋しく思うことがあるんでしょうか。
lines.direction: Quiet, intimate, unhurried alto.
lines.context: Scene 'The Sealed Conservatory'. Answering Vespera: "Someone taught the glass to remember a room that is gone."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: The handless watch was in the portrait.
lines.ja: あの肖像画にも……針のない懐中時計が描かれていたな。
lines.tts_text: <breath> あの肖像画にも……針のない懐中時計が描かれていたな。
lines.direction: Grim, observant low baritone connecting the clue in the family portrait.
lines.context: Scene 'The Manor Gives Way'. Answering Mirel: "Seven notches. The same seal. And these initials: C.V."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: The name is not in the ledger. We should keep moving.
lines.ja: 台帳にその名前はない。先を急ぎましょう。
lines.tts_text: 台帳にその名前はない。先を急ぎましょう。
lines.direction: Cool, tightly controlled aristocratic alto.
lines.context: Scene 'The Manor Gives Way'. Answering Mahmut: "The handless watch was in the portrait."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: The letters have found us again. I know whose hand wrote them.
lines.ja: あの文字が、また私たちを見つけた。誰の手で書かれたのか、私は知っている。
lines.tts_text: <breath> あの文字が、また私たちを見つけた。誰の手で書かれたのか、私は知っている。
lines.direction: Internal monologue (close-mic inner thought): Soft, fearful, unguarded alto; quiet dread as the curse nears her heart. Delivered in an intimate, hushed self-reflective cadence.
lines.context: Scene 'The Manor Gives Way'. Answering Fadyme: "The name is not in the ledger. We should keep moving."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Let the arch go. I have the child.
lines.ja: アーチから手を離せ！ 子どもは俺が抱えている！
lines.tts_text: アーチから手を離せ！ 子どもは俺が抱えている！
lines.direction: Urgent, commanding baritone rescuing the child under the collapsing archway.
lines.context: Scene 'The Manor Gives Way'. First line of the scene.

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: I have it. Go.
lines.ja: 支えてる。行って。
lines.tts_text: <exhales> 支えてる。行って。
lines.direction: Strained, breathless alto; masking physical pain behind a tight, controlled cadence.
lines.context: Scene 'The Manor Gives Way'. Answering Mahmut: "Let the arch go. I have the child."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Dust. It is only dust.
lines.ja: 埃よ。ただの埃。
lines.tts_text: <exhales> 埃よ。ただの埃。
lines.direction: Faint, exhausted yet affectionate alto; a tired smile after surviving the ordeal.
lines.context: Scene 'The Manor Gives Way'. Answering Hana: "Fadyme, your sleeve—"

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Hana. Please do not tell him.
lines.ja: ハナ。お願い、彼には言わないで。
lines.tts_text: ハナ。お願い、彼には言わないで。
lines.direction: Low, hushed, serious alto spoken in confidence.
lines.context: Scene 'The Manor Gives Way'. Answering Fadyme: "Dust. It is only dust."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: For the heir. The ink says no more.
lines.ja: 世継ぎのための日程よ。インクは、それ以上何も言っていない。
lines.tts_text: 世継ぎのための日程よ。インクは、それ以上何も言っていない。
lines.direction: Poised, graceful alto deflecting concern with dry, effortless elegance.
lines.context: Scene 'The Ashen Lord’s Wraith'. Answering Aveline: "A schedule for what?"

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Then we find the altar before the next line is written.
lines.ja: なら、次の行が書かれる前に、祭壇を見つけ出す。
lines.tts_text: なら、次の行が書かれる前に、祭壇を見つけ出す。
lines.direction: Resolved, urgent baritone after discovering the succession ledger.
lines.context: Scene 'The Ashen Lord’s Wraith'. Answering Fadyme: "For the heir. The ink says no more."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Then we end the memory.
lines.ja: なら、その記憶をここで終わらせよう。
lines.tts_text: なら、その記憶をここで終わらせよう。
lines.direction: Solemn, commanding baritone facing the noble's wraith.
lines.context: Scene 'The Ashen Lord’s Wraith'. Answering Mirel: "It is copying the portraits. Break the mirror frame."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Then your family tried to mend a wound it did not make.
lines.ja: なら、あなたの家族は、自分たちがつけたわけじゃない傷を繕おうとしたのね。
lines.tts_text: なら、あなたの家族は、自分たちがつけたわけじゃない傷を繕おうとしたのね。
lines.direction: Soft, soothing, compassionate alto; unhurried and kind.
lines.context: Scene 'The Stair of Seven Chains'. Answering Jori: "The hammer marks are mine. My grandmother's, before me. We repaired these chains after the first eclipse."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: We find the answer together. No one goes ahead alone.
lines.ja: 答えは一緒に見つける。誰ひとり、先へは行かせない。
lines.tts_text: 答えは一緒に見つける。誰ひとり、先へは行かせない。
lines.direction: Protective, deeply devoted baritone looking directly at Fadyme.
lines.context: Scene 'The Stair of Seven Chains'. Answering Nixie: "The chain-bearers up there sing to it. They think the eclipse is holding its breath for the kingdom."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: You say that as if I am the one who keeps trying to disappear.
lines.ja: まるで、いつも消えようとしているのが私みたいな言い方ね。
lines.tts_text: まるで、いつも消えようとしているのが私みたいな言い方ね。
lines.direction: Light, conversational alto with effortless charm.
lines.context: Scene 'The Stair of Seven Chains'. Answering Mahmut: "We find the answer together. No one goes ahead alone."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: When this is over, I want to hear every detail of that barricade.
lines.ja: 全部終わったら、そのバリケードの話、ひとつ残らず聞かせて。
lines.tts_text: 全部終わったら、そのバリケードの話、ひとつ残らず聞かせて。
lines.direction: Tender, heartfelt alto radiating quiet gratitude and companionship.
lines.context: Scene 'Those Who Held the Road'. Answering Marek: "The road is ours. Go finish what we began."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: When this is over. I will keep borrowing those words until there are none left.
lines.ja: 全部終わったら。……その言葉を、尽きるまで借り続けよう。
lines.tts_text: <sigh> 全部終わったら。……その言葉を、尽きるまで借り続けよう。
lines.direction: Wistful, reflective inner alto; mournful and unhurried.
lines.context: Scene 'Those Who Held the Road'. Answering Fadyme: "When this is over, I want to hear every detail of that barricade."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: You have already done enough. Get everyone home.
lines.ja: あんたはもう十分すぎるほどやってくれた。皆を連れて帰れ。
lines.tts_text: あんたはもう十分すぎるほどやってくれた。皆を連れて帰れ。
lines.direction: Grateful, warm veteran baritone thanking an ally holding the rear.
lines.context: Scene 'Those Who Held the Road'. Answering Nara: "Two sentinels are winding up a flank attack. Mahmut, your left side is about to become very popular."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Veyr?
lines.ja: ……ヴェア、だと？
lines.tts_text: <breath> ……ヴェア、だと？
lines.direction: Surprised, hushed baritone realizing the royal house name inscribed on the altar.
lines.context: Scene 'The Names We Kept'. Answering Aveline: "Fadyme Veyr. The record accepts the ink."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: My mother's name. It was hers before it was mine.
lines.ja: お母様の名前よ。私のものになる前は、お母様のものだった。
lines.tts_text: お母様の名前よ。私のものになる前は、お母様のものだった。
lines.direction: Measured, guarded alto keeping her composure tight.
lines.context: Scene 'The Names We Kept'. Answering Mahmut: "Veyr?"

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: I am sorry. I wanted one more quiet day before you knew even this much.
lines.ja: ごめんなさい。これだけのことでも、あなたが知る前に、もう一日だけ、静かな日が欲しかった。
lines.tts_text: <sigh> ごめんなさい。これだけのことでも、あなたが知る前に、もう一日だけ、静かな日が欲しかった。
lines.direction: Internal monologue (close-mic inner thought): Soft, apologetic alto carrying quiet guilt. Delivered in an intimate, hushed self-reflective cadence.
lines.context: Scene 'The Names We Kept'. Answering Fadyme: "My mother's name. It was hers before it was mine."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: I came here to be offered. They are asking me to be witnessed.
lines.ja: 私は、捧げられるためにここへ来た。なのに皆は、私を見届けたいと言ってくれる。
lines.tts_text: <breath> 私は、捧げられるためにここへ来た。なのに皆は、私を見届けたいと言ってくれる。
lines.direction: Internal monologue (close-mic inner thought): Poised, luminous gothic alto; unhurried cadence with quiet dignity and natural breath. Delivered in an intimate, hushed self-reflective cadence.
lines.context: Scene 'The Names We Kept'. Answering Aveline: "I can read the prayer beneath it. The names were offered as witnesses, not sacrifices."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Then write it back. A name should not vanish just because someone feared what it meant.
lines.ja: なら、書き戻して。何を意味するかを恐れられたからといって、名前が消えていいはずがないわ。
lines.tts_text: なら、書き戻して。何を意味するかを恐れられたからといって、名前が消えていいはずがないわ。
lines.direction: Poised, luminous gothic alto; unhurried cadence with quiet dignity and natural breath.
lines.context: Scene 'The Names We Kept'. Answering Kera: "There is one space scraped clean. It is the same length as Fadyme's name."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Mahmut, after this, stay beside me. Just for a little while.
lines.ja: マフムト。これが終わったら、そばにいて。少しの間だけでいいから。
lines.tts_text: <breath> マフムト。これが終わったら、そばにいて。少しの間だけでいいから。
lines.direction: Soft, unguarded, intimate alto; speaking with fragile honesty and quiet trust.
lines.context: Scene 'Before the Last Toll'. Answering Aveline: "The pulse is stopped. The altar is open."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: As long as you ask me to.
lines.ja: ああ。お前が望む限り、いつまでも傍にいる。
lines.tts_text: <breath> ああ。お前が望む限り、いつまでも傍にいる。
lines.direction: Deeply gentle, devoted low baritone; an unconditional vow spoken quietly.
lines.context: Scene 'Before the Last Toll'. Answering Fadyme: "Mahmut, after this, stay beside me. Just for a little while."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: I do not know how to ask for forever. I will ask for one more step.
lines.ja: 『ずっと』の頼み方なんて、わからない。だから、あと一歩だけを頼もう。
lines.tts_text: <breath> 『ずっと』の頼み方なんて、わからない。だから、あと一歩だけを頼もう。
lines.direction: Internal monologue (close-mic inner thought): Delicate, exhausted alto; soft and slightly breathless, carrying hidden physical weakness. Delivered in an intimate, hushed self-reflective cadence.
lines.context: Scene 'Before the Last Toll'. Answering Mahmut: "As long as you ask me to."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: I promise to try.
lines.ja: やってみるって、約束する。
lines.tts_text: <breath> やってみるって、約束する。
lines.direction: Soft, gentle alto near a whisper.
lines.context: Scene 'Before the Last Toll'. Answering Hana: "I will. And Fadyme—I kept my promise. Come back, so I can stop keeping it."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: You do not have to promise alone.
lines.ja: ひとりで約束しなくていい。俺もここにいる。
lines.tts_text: <breath> ひとりで約束しなくていい。俺もここにいる。
lines.direction: Tender, unwavering baritone; sharing the weight of her promise.
lines.context: Scene 'Before the Last Toll'. Answering Fadyme: "I promise to try."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Then stop asking the living to pay it.
lines.ja: なら、生きている人に払わせるのはやめなさい！
lines.tts_text: なら、生きている人に払わせるのはやめなさい！
lines.direction: Fierce, resonant, defiant alto standing against the Eclipse Construct.
lines.context: Scene 'The Eclipse Construct'. Answering Eclipse Construct: "THE HOUR IS UNPAID."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Fadyme, stay behind me!
lines.ja: ファディメ、俺の後ろに下がれ！
lines.tts_text: ファディメ、俺の後ろに下がれ！
lines.direction: Alarmed, urgent combat cry as the Eclipse Construct unleashes its phase-2 ward.
lines.context: Scene 'The Eclipse Construct'. Answering Vespera (memory): "The ward is using the bearer as its anchor! Break the pylons!"

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: I am right here. Finish it with me.
lines.ja: ここにいるわ。一緒に、終わらせて。
lines.tts_text: <exhales> ここにいるわ。一緒に、終わらせて。
lines.direction: Strained, breathless alto; masking physical pain behind a tight, controlled cadence.
lines.context: Scene 'The Eclipse Construct'. Answering Mahmut: "Fadyme, stay behind me!"

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: It is over.
lines.ja: ……終わったのね。
lines.tts_text: <exhales> ……終わったのね。
lines.direction: Soft, relieved alto exhale; letting go of tension beside the people she trusts.
lines.context: Scene 'The Eclipse Construct'. Answering Eclipse Construct: "WITNESS... RESTORED. HOUR... STILL OWED."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Fadyme? Your hand—
lines.ja: ファディメ……！？ お前の手、それは——
lines.tts_text: <breath> ファディメ……！？ お前の手、それは——
lines.direction: Sudden, breathless fear and shock as he sees the black curse veins spreading across her hand.
lines.context: Scene 'The Eclipse Construct'. Answering Fadyme: "It is over."

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: I am only tired. Please, Mahmut. Not here.
lines.ja: 少し疲れただけ。お願い、マフムト。ここでは、やめて。
lines.tts_text: <exhales> 少し疲れただけ。お願い、マフムト。ここでは、やめて。
lines.direction: Faint, exhausted yet affectionate alto; a tired smile after surviving the ordeal.
lines.context: Scene 'The Eclipse Construct'. Answering Mahmut: "Fadyme? Your hand—"

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: The dark has reached my heart. I cannot make it wait much longer.
lines.ja: 闇が、心臓まで届いた。もう、長くは待たせられない。
lines.tts_text: <breath> 闇が、心臓まで届いた。もう、長くは待たせられない。
lines.direction: Breathless, shaken inner alto; fighting back terror in a near-whisper.
lines.context: Scene 'The Eclipse Construct'. Answering Fadyme: "I am only tired. Please, Mahmut. Not here."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Five of us. We have broken worse lines than this.
lines.ja: 俺たち五人だ。これより酷い戦線も、共に打ち破ってきた。
lines.tts_text: 俺たち五人だ。これより酷い戦線も、共に打ち破ってきた。
lines.direction: Steady, inspiring knight baritone before the final altar construct.
lines.context: Scene 'The Eclipse Construct'. First line of the scene.

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: And if the altar asks for a name?
lines.ja: もし祭壇が、名前を求めてきたら？
lines.tts_text: もし祭壇が、名前を求めてきたら？
lines.direction: Quiet, intimate, unhurried alto.
lines.context: Scene 'The Eclipse Construct'. Answering Mahmut: "Five of us. We have broken worse lines than this."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: It can have mine first.
lines.ja: 名前を求めるなら、まず俺の名前からくれてやる。
lines.tts_text: 名前を求めるなら、まず俺の名前からくれてやる。
lines.direction: Certain, fierce, unhesitating baritone; ready to give his own name before hers.
lines.context: Scene 'The Eclipse Construct'. Answering Fadyme: "And if the altar asks for a name?"

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: No. We leave with all five names. That is the only answer I will accept.
lines.ja: だめ。五人とも、自分の名前を持って帰るの。それ以外の答えは、受け入れないわ。
lines.tts_text: だめ。五人とも、自分の名前を持って帰るの。それ以外の答えは、受け入れないわ。
lines.direction: Tender, heartfelt alto radiating quiet gratitude and companionship.
lines.context: Scene 'The Eclipse Construct'. Answering Mahmut: "It can have mine first."

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Mahmut. No title. The crest came off years ago. The shield did not.
lines.ja: マフムトだ。肩書きはない。紋章なら何年も前に剥がれたが、この盾だけは残っている。
lines.tts_text: <breath> マフムトだ。肩書きはない。紋章なら何年も前に剥がれたが、この盾だけは残っている。
lines.direction: Grounded, weathered knight baritone introducing himself without pretension.
lines.context: Battle/hub bark: introducing themself when first recruited.

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Front line. Mine.
lines.ja: 前衛は、俺が引き受ける。
lines.tts_text: 前衛は、俺が引き受ける。
lines.direction: Steady, reliable low baritone stepping into the front line.
lines.context: Battle/hub bark: joining the battle party.

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: If you are waiting for me to rest, it will be a long wait.
lines.ja: 俺が休むのを待っているなら、ずいぶん長い待ち時間になるぞ。
lines.tts_text: <exhales> 俺が休むのを待っているなら、ずいぶん長い待ち時間になるぞ。
lines.direction: Dry, quietly amused veteran baritone.
lines.context: Battle/hub bark: idle remark on the hub screen.

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Hold.
lines.ja: 踏みとどまれ！
lines.tts_text: 踏みとどまれ！
lines.direction: Firm, heavy shield-bash combat baritone.
lines.context: Battle/hub bark: short battle cry on a basic attack.

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Behind me.
lines.ja: 俺の後ろへ！
lines.tts_text: 俺の後ろへ！
lines.direction: Urgent, protective vanguard baritone raising his shield wall.
lines.context: Battle/hub bark: battle cry when using a skill.

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Last wall. Stand fast!
lines.ja: ここが最後の壁だ——一歩も退くな！
lines.tts_text: ここが最後の壁だ——一歩も退くな！
lines.direction: Heroic, roaring yet controlled veteran commander baritone; unbreakable bastion ultimate.
lines.context: Battle/hub bark: full-voiced battle cry on the ultimate.

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Everyone up? Good.
lines.ja: 全員、立っているか？ ……なら上出来だ。
lines.tts_text: <exhales> 全員、立っているか？ ……なら上出来だ。
lines.direction: Relieved, grounded post-battle baritone checking on his companions first.
lines.context: Battle/hub bark: after winning a battle.

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: ...I was too slow.
lines.ja: ……俺が、遅すぎたか……。
lines.tts_text: <sigh> ……俺が、遅すぎたか……。
lines.direction: Breathless, devastated low baritone falling to one knee.
lines.context: Battle/hub bark: falling in battle.

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: Not yet.
lines.ja: ……まだだ。まだ倒れん。
lines.tts_text: <breath> ……まだだ。まだ倒れん。
lines.direction: Gritty, strained, unyielding baritone bracing behind his cracked shield.
lines.context: Battle/hub bark: badly hurt, still fighting.

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: She says she is fine. I have learned to count how often.
lines.ja: あいつはいつも『平気だ』と言う。……俺はもう、その回数を数えるようになった。
lines.tts_text: <sigh> あいつはいつも『平気だ』と言う。……俺はもう、その回数を数えるようになった。
lines.direction: Quietly worried, tender low baritone speaking of Fadyme's habit of hiding her pain.
lines.context: Battle/hub bark: a personal remark about a companion.

lines.speaker: mahmut
lines.en: He taught me the shield. I will not thank him for the rest.
lines.ja: 盾の扱いはあの人に教わった。……だが、それ以外のことで礼を言うつもりはない。
lines.tts_text: 盾の扱いはあの人に教わった。……だが、それ以外のことで礼を言うつもりはない。
lines.direction: Somber, guarded baritone reflecting on Commander Oren.
lines.context: Battle/hub bark: a deeper personal remark.

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Fadyme. Just Fadyme, for now. The rest of the name is heavier than it looks.
lines.ja: ファディメ。今は、ただのファディメよ。残りの名前は、見た目よりずっと重いの。
lines.tts_text: ファディメ。今は、ただのファディメよ。残りの名前は、見た目よりずっと重いの。
lines.direction: Poised, luminous gothic alto; unhurried cadence with quiet dignity and natural breath.
lines.context: Battle/hub bark: introducing themself when first recruited.

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: I will be right behind him. Someone has to be.
lines.ja: 私は、彼のすぐ後ろにいるわ。誰かが、そうしなくちゃ。
lines.tts_text: 私は、彼のすぐ後ろにいるわ。誰かが、そうしなくちゃ。
lines.direction: Poised, luminous gothic alto; unhurried cadence with quiet dignity and natural breath.
lines.context: Battle/hub bark: joining the battle party.

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: If I sit still long enough, I can hear every bell in the kingdom. Please talk to me.
lines.ja: じっとしていると、この国じゅうの鐘が聞こえてしまうの。……ねえ、話しかけて。
lines.tts_text: じっとしていると、この国じゅうの鐘が聞こえてしまうの。……ねえ、話しかけて。
lines.direction: Poised, luminous gothic alto; unhurried cadence with quiet dignity and natural breath.
lines.context: Battle/hub bark: idle remark on the hub screen.

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Thorn.
lines.ja: とげよ。
lines.tts_text: とげよ。
lines.direction: Poised, luminous gothic alto; unhurried cadence with quiet dignity and natural breath.
lines.context: Battle/hub bark: short battle cry on a basic attack.

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Borrow this hour.
lines.ja: このときを、借りるわ。
lines.tts_text: このときを、借りるわ。
lines.direction: Poised, luminous gothic alto; unhurried cadence with quiet dignity and natural breath.
lines.context: Battle/hub bark: battle cry when using a skill.

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Listen—the bell forgets!
lines.ja: 聴いて——鐘は、忘れる！
lines.tts_text: 聴いて——鐘は、忘れる！
lines.direction: Poised, luminous gothic alto; unhurried cadence with quiet dignity and natural breath.
lines.context: Battle/hub bark: full-voiced battle cry on the ultimate.

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: We all walk away. That is the only victory I count.
lines.ja: みんなで帰れる。私が数える勝利は、それだけよ。
lines.tts_text: みんなで帰れる。私が数える勝利は、それだけよ。
lines.direction: Poised, luminous gothic alto; unhurried cadence with quiet dignity and natural breath.
lines.context: Battle/hub bark: after winning a battle.

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: I am... fine...
lines.ja: 私は……平気……
lines.tts_text: 私は……平気……
lines.direction: Poised, luminous gothic alto; unhurried cadence with quiet dignity and natural breath.
lines.context: Battle/hub bark: falling in battle.

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: I am perfectly fine.
lines.ja: ……私は、まったく平気よ。
lines.tts_text: ……私は、まったく平気よ。
lines.direction: Poised young woman putting on a brave, gentle smile ('I am perfectly fine') while subtly hiding exhaustion and chill beneath her warm, composed alto.
lines.context: Battle/hub bark: badly hurt, still fighting.

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: He cuts cheese like it owes the Crown money.
lines.ja: あの人、王冠に借金でもあるみたいにチーズを切るの。
lines.tts_text: あの人、王冠に借金でもあるみたいにチーズを切るの。
lines.direction: Poised, luminous gothic alto; unhurried cadence with quiet dignity and natural breath.
lines.context: Battle/hub bark: a personal remark about a companion.

lines.speaker: fadyme
lines.en: Clem keeps my name in her book. I hope she has good ink.
lines.ja: クレムは、名簿に私の名前を残してくれている。いいインクだといいけれど。
lines.tts_text: クレムは、名簿に私の名前を残してくれている。いいインクだといいけれど。
lines.direction: Poised, luminous gothic alto; unhurried cadence with quiet dignity and natural breath.
lines.context: Battle/hub bark: a deeper personal remark.
